objects.sql:
CREATE TABLE access_status_history (
  event_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY CHECK (length(event_id) BETWEEN 16 AND 96),
  telegram_id INTEGER,
  plan_code TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (plan_code IN ('free', 'professional', 'dragon')),
  from_state TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (from_state IN (

  ),

    external_revoked_at IS NULL OR external_revoked_at > 0
  ),

  CHECK (
    (external_consent_version = '' AND external_consented_at IS NULL)

objects.name: admin_ai_chat_turns
objects.sql:
CREATE TABLE admin_ai_chat_turns (
  request_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY CHECK (length(request_id) BETWEEN 16 AND 96),
  admin_telegram_id INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (admin_telegram_id > 0),
  telegram_update_id INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (telegram_update_id >= 0),
  requested_model TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (requested_model IN ('qwen', 'deepseek')),
  final_model_alias TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'none' CHECK (
    final_model_alias IN ('none', 'qwen_safe', 'deepseek_flash_dragon')
  ),
  prompt_hash TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(prompt_hash) = 64),
  user_message TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '' CHECK (length(user_message) <= 2500),
  assistant_message TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT ''
    CHECK (length(assistant_message) <= 3500),
  status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending'
    CHECK (status IN ('pending', 'completed', 'failed')),
  error_code TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '' CHECK (length(error_code) <= 80),
  billed_tokens INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (billed_tokens >= 0),
  cost_microusd INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (cost_microusd >= 0),
  latency_ms INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (latency_ms >= 0),
  created_at INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (created_at > 0),
  completed_at INTEGER CHECK (completed_at IS NULL OR completed_at >= created_at),
  UNIQUE (admin_telegram_id, telegram_update_id),
  CHECK (
    (status = 'pending' AND final_model_alias = 'none'
      AND user_message = '' AND assistant_message = ''
      AND error_code = '' AND completed_at IS NULL)
    OR
    (status = 'completed' AND final_model_alias != 'none'
      AND length(user_message) BETWEEN 1 AND 2500
      AND length(assistant_message) BETWEEN 1 AND 3500
      AND error_code = '' AND completed_at IS NOT NULL)
    OR
    (status = 'failed' AND final_model_alias = 'none'
      AND user_message = '' AND assistant_message = ''
      AND length(error_code) BETWEEN 3 AND 80
      AND completed_at IS NOT NULL)
  )
)

CREATE TABLE ai_draft_versions (
  version_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY CHECK (length(version_id) = 36),
  version_key TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE
    CHECK (length(version_key) BETWEEN 16 AND 160),
  request_id TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE
    CHECK (length(request_id) BETWEEN 16 AND 96),
  draft_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES ai_drafts(draft_id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  version_no INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (version_no > 0),
  version_origin TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (version_origin IN ('ai', 'user')),
  generation_state TEXT NOT NULL
    CHECK (generation_state IN ('complete', 'stopped')),
  content TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(content) <= 12000),
  structured_payload_json TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (
    json_valid(structured_payload_json)
    AND json_type(structured_payload_json) = 'object'
  ),
  fact_source_ids_json TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (
    json_valid(fact_source_ids_json)
    AND json_type(fact_source_ids_json) = 'array'
    AND json_array_length(fact_source_ids_json) BETWEEN 1 AND 32
  ),
  warnings_json TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]' CHECK (
    json_valid(warnings_json) AND json_type(warnings_json) = 'array'
  ),
  content_hash TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(content_hash) = 64),
  model_alias TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (model_alias IN (
    'qwen_safe', 'deepseek_flash_dragon', 'human_edit'
  )),
  prompt_version TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(prompt_version) BETWEEN 8 AND 80),
  schema_version INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK (schema_version = 1),
  policy_version TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(policy_version) BETWEEN 8 AND 80),
  created_at INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (created_at > 0),
  UNIQUE (draft_id, version_no),
  CHECK (
    (generation_state = 'complete' AND length(trim(content)) > 0)
    OR generation_state = 'stopped'
  ),
  CHECK (
    (version_origin = 'user' AND model_alias = 'human_edit')
    OR (version_origin = 'ai' AND model_alias != 'human_edit')
  )
)

  updated_at INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (updated_at >= created_at),

  CHECK (

      AND deleted_at IS NOT NULL AND deleted_at >= created_at)
    OR (draft_state != 'deleted' AND deleted_at IS NULL)

objects.name: ai_gateway_attempts
objects.sql:
CREATE TABLE ai_gateway_attempts (
  attempt_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY CHECK (length(attempt_id) = 36),
  request_id TEXT NOT NULL
    REFERENCES ai_gateway_budget_reservations(request_id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  attempt_no INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (attempt_no BETWEEN 1 AND 3),
  route_step TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (
    route_step IN ('primary', 'retry', 'fallback')
  ),
  model_alias TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (
    model_alias IN ('qwen_safe', 'deepseek_flash_dragon')
  ),
  provider_code TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (
    provider_code IN ('cloudflare', 'deepseek')
  ),
  attempt_status TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (
    attempt_status IN ('success', 'failed', 'timeout')
  ),
  input_tokens INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0
    CHECK (input_tokens BETWEEN 0 AND 10000000),
  cached_input_tokens INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (
    cached_input_tokens BETWEEN 0 AND input_tokens
  ),
  output_tokens INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0
    CHECK (output_tokens BETWEEN 0 AND 10000000),
  cost_microusd INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0
    CHECK (cost_microusd BETWEEN 0 AND 2000000),
  latency_ms INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (latency_ms BETWEEN 0 AND 300000),
  status_code INTEGER CHECK (
    status_code IS NULL OR status_code BETWEEN 100 AND 599
  ),
  error_code TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '' CHECK (length(error_code) <= 80),
  created_at INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (created_at > 0),
  UNIQUE (request_id, attempt_no),
  UNIQUE (request_id, route_step),
  CHECK (
    (model_alias = 'deepseek_flash_dragon' AND provider_code = 'deepseek')
    OR
    (model_alias = 'qwen_safe' AND provider_code = 'cloudflare')
  ),
  CHECK (
    (route_step = 'primary' AND attempt_no = 1)
    OR
    (route_step = 'retry' AND attempt_no = 2
      AND model_alias = 'deepseek_flash_dragon')
    OR
    (route_step = 'fallback' AND attempt_no BETWEEN 2 AND 3
      AND model_alias = 'qwen_safe')
  ),
  CHECK (
    (attempt_status = 'success' AND error_code = '')
    OR
    (attempt_status != 'success' AND length(error_code) BETWEEN 3 AND 80)
  )
)

    REFERENCES users(telegram_id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  usage_date TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (
    length(usage_date) = 10
    AND substr(usage_date, 5, 1) = '-'
    AND substr(usage_date, 8, 1) = '-'
  ),
  user_cycle_start_at INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (user_cycle_start_at > 0),
  user_cycle_end_at INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (
    user_cycle_end_at = user_cycle_start_at + 2592000
  ),
  global_cycle_start_at INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (global_cycle_start_at > 0),
  global_cycle_end_at INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (
    global_cycle_end_at = global_cycle_start_at + 2592000
  ),
  reserved_billed_tokens INTEGER NOT NULL
    CHECK (reserved_billed_tokens BETWEEN 1 AND 100000000),
  reserved_cost_microusd INTEGER NOT NULL
    CHECK (reserved_cost_microusd BETWEEN 0 AND 2000000),
  reservation_state TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'reserved'
    CHECK (reservation_state IN ('reserved', 'consumed', 'released')),
  policy_version TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(policy_version) BETWEEN 8 AND 80),
  pricing_version TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(pricing_version) BETWEEN 8 AND 80),
  created_at INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (created_at > 0),
  completed_at INTEGER,
  CHECK (
    (reservation_state = 'reserved' AND completed_at IS NULL)
    OR
    (reservation_state IN ('consumed', 'released')
      AND completed_at IS NOT NULL AND completed_at >= created_at)
  )
)

    AND substr(provider_user_id, 1, 5) = 'reai_'
  ),
  data_class TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (data_class IN ('public', 'private')),
  primary_model_alias TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (
    primary_model_alias IN ('qwen_safe', 'deepseek_flash_dragon')
  ),
  final_model_alias TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (
    final_model_alias IN ('qwen_safe', 'deepseek_flash_dragon', 'none')
  ),
  attempt_count INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (attempt_count BETWEEN 1 AND 3),
  retry_count INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (retry_count BETWEEN 0 AND 1),
  fallback_used INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (fallback_used IN (0, 1)),
  total_latency_ms INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (
    total_latency_ms BETWEEN 0 AND 900000
  ),
  cached_input_tokens INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0
    CHECK (cached_input_tokens BETWEEN 0 AND 30000000),
  billed_tokens INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0
    CHECK (billed_tokens BETWEEN 0 AND 30000000),
  cost_microusd INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0
    CHECK (cost_microusd BETWEEN 0 AND 2000000),
  cache_scope TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (cache_scope IN ('none', 'public', 'private')),
  cache_key_hash TEXT CHECK (
    cache_key_hash IS NULL OR length(cache_key_hash) = 64
  ),
  pricing_version TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(pricing_version) BETWEEN 8 AND 80),
  policy_version TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(policy_version) BETWEEN 8 AND 80),
  created_at INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (created_at > 0),
  CHECK (
    (cache_scope = 'none' AND cache_key_hash IS NULL)
    OR (cache_scope != 'none' AND cache_key_hash IS NOT NULL)
  ),
  CHECK (data_class = 'public' OR cache_scope != 'public'),
  CHECK (fallback_used = 0 OR final_model_alias IN ('qwen_safe', 'none')),
  CHECK (retry_count < attempt_count)
)

objects.name: ai_generation_actions
objects.sql:
CREATE TABLE ai_generation_actions (
  action_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY CHECK (length(action_id) = 36),
  action_key TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE CHECK (length(action_key) BETWEEN 16 AND 160),
  generation_id TEXT NOT NULL
    REFERENCES ai_generation_sessions(generation_id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  owner_telegram_id INTEGER NOT NULL
    REFERENCES users(telegram_id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  action_type TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (action_type IN (
    'start', 'stop', 'retry', 'finalize', 'complete', 'fail'
  )),
  from_state TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (from_state IN (
    '', 'streaming', 'stopped', 'finalizing', 'failed'
  )),
  to_state TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (to_state IN (
    'streaming', 'stopped', 'finalizing', 'completed', 'failed'
  )),
  attempt_no INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (attempt_no BETWEEN 1 AND 100),
  detail_code TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '' CHECK (length(detail_code) <= 80),
  created_at INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (created_at > 0),
  CHECK (
    (action_type = 'start' AND from_state = ''
      AND to_state = 'streaming' AND attempt_no = 1)
    OR (action_type = 'stop' AND from_state = 'streaming'
      AND to_state = 'stopped')
    OR (action_type = 'retry' AND from_state IN ('stopped', 'failed')
      AND to_state = 'streaming')
    OR (action_type = 'finalize' AND from_state = 'streaming'
      AND to_state = 'finalizing')
    OR (action_type = 'complete' AND from_state = 'finalizing'
      AND to_state = 'completed')
    OR (action_type = 'fail' AND from_state IN ('streaming', 'finalizing')
      AND to_state = 'failed' AND length(detail_code) BETWEEN 3 AND 80)
  )
)

objects.name: ai_generation_sessions
objects.sql:
CREATE TABLE ai_generation_sessions (
  generation_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY CHECK (length(generation_id) = 36),
  generation_key TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE
    CHECK (length(generation_key) BETWEEN 16 AND 160),
  owner_telegram_id INTEGER NOT NULL
    REFERENCES users(telegram_id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  source_draft_id TEXT REFERENCES ai_drafts(draft_id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  draft_id TEXT REFERENCES ai_drafts(draft_id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  draft_request_key TEXT NOT NULL
    CHECK (length(draft_request_key) BETWEEN 16 AND 160),
  version_request_id TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE
    CHECK (length(version_request_id) BETWEEN 16 AND 96),
  draft_type TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (draft_type IN (
    'telegram_post', 'private_message', 'short_card', 'promotion_idea',
    'short_video_script', 'offer_explanation'
  )),
  draft_title TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '' CHECK (length(draft_title) <= 160),
  base_version_no INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (base_version_no >= 0),
  model_alias TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (model_alias IN (
    'qwen_safe', 'deepseek_flash_dragon'
  )),
  fact_source_ids_json TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (
    json_valid(fact_source_ids_json)
    AND json_type(fact_source_ids_json) = 'array'
    AND json_array_length(fact_source_ids_json) BETWEEN 1 AND 32
  ),
  fact_bundle_hash TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(fact_bundle_hash) = 64),
  prompt_hash TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(prompt_hash) = 64),
  request_fingerprint TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(request_fingerprint) = 64),
  generation_state TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (generation_state IN (
    'streaming', 'stopped', 'finalizing', 'completed', 'failed'
  )),
  attempt_no INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1
    CHECK (attempt_no BETWEEN 1 AND 100),
  streamed_chars INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0
    CHECK (streamed_chars BETWEEN 0 AND 12000),
  stream_digest TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT ''
    CHECK (length(stream_digest) IN (0, 64)),
  version_id TEXT REFERENCES ai_draft_versions(version_id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  failure_code TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '' CHECK (length(failure_code) <= 80),
  created_at INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (created_at > 0),
  updated_at INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (updated_at >= created_at),
  stopped_at INTEGER,
  completed_at INTEGER,
  revision INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK (revision >= 1),
  CHECK (
    (generation_state = 'streaming'
      AND stopped_at IS NULL AND completed_at IS NULL
      AND version_id IS NULL AND failure_code = '')
    OR
    (generation_state = 'stopped'
      AND stopped_at IS NOT NULL AND stopped_at >= created_at
      AND completed_at IS NULL AND version_id IS NULL AND failure_code = '')
    OR
    (generation_state = 'finalizing'
      AND stopped_at IS NULL AND completed_at IS NULL
      AND version_id IS NULL AND failure_code = '')
    OR
    (generation_state = 'completed'
      AND stopped_at IS NULL
      AND completed_at IS NOT NULL AND completed_at >= created_at
      AND draft_id IS NOT NULL AND version_id IS NOT NULL
      AND length(stream_digest) = 64 AND failure_code = '')
    OR
    (generation_state = 'failed'
      AND stopped_at IS NULL AND completed_at IS NULL
      AND version_id IS NULL AND length(failure_code) BETWEEN 3 AND 80)
  )
)

objects.name: ai_partner_runtime_settings
objects.sql:
CREATE TABLE ai_partner_runtime_settings (
  id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY CHECK (id = 1),
  rollout_mode TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'off'
    CHECK (rollout_mode IN ('off', 'admin')),
  master_enabled INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0
    CHECK (master_enabled IN (0, 1)),
  external_provider_enabled INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0
    CHECK (external_provider_enabled IN (0, 1)),
  primary_model_alias TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'qwen_safe'
    CHECK (primary_model_alias = 'qwen_safe'),
  dragon_model_alias TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'deepseek_flash_dragon'
    CHECK (dragon_model_alias = 'deepseek_flash_dragon'),
  fallback_model_alias TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'qwen_safe'
    CHECK (fallback_model_alias = 'qwen_safe'),
  external_model_name TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'deepseek-flash'
    CHECK (external_model_name = 'deepseek-flash'),
  thinking_enabled INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0
    CHECK (thinking_enabled = 0),
  dragon_daily_burst_limit INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 100
    CHECK (dragon_daily_burst_limit BETWEEN 1 AND 100),
  dragon_cycle_success_limit INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 900
    CHECK (
      dragon_cycle_success_limit BETWEEN dragon_daily_burst_limit AND 900
    ),
  quota_cycle_days INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 30
    CHECK (quota_cycle_days = 30),
  quota_cycle_carryover_enabled INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0
    CHECK (quota_cycle_carryover_enabled = 0),
  max_concurrent_per_user INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1
    CHECK (max_concurrent_per_user = 1),
  max_provider_retries INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1
    CHECK (max_provider_retries BETWEEN 0 AND 1),
  pilot_user_limit INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 10
    CHECK (pilot_user_limit BETWEEN 1 AND 10),
  user_cycle_cost_ceiling_microusd INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 2000000
    CHECK (user_cycle_cost_ceiling_microusd BETWEEN 1 AND 2000000),
  global_cycle_cost_ceiling_microusd INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 20000000
    CHECK (
      global_cycle_cost_ceiling_microusd
        BETWEEN user_cycle_cost_ceiling_microusd AND 20000000
    ),
  memory_exchange_limit INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 5
    CHECK (memory_exchange_limit BETWEEN 0 AND 5),
  confirmation_ttl_seconds INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 600
    CHECK (confirmation_ttl_seconds BETWEEN 60 AND 600),
  telemetry_retention_days INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 90
    CHECK (telemetry_retention_days BETWEEN 1 AND 90),
  policy_version TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '2026-09-12.ai-partner-v1'
    CHECK (length(policy_version) BETWEEN 8 AND 80),
  updated_by INTEGER,
  updated_at INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (updated_at > 0),
  CHECK (
    master_enabled = 0
    OR rollout_mode = 'admin'
  ),
  CHECK (
    external_provider_enabled = 0
    OR (master_enabled = 1 AND rollout_mode = 'admin')
  )
)

objects.name: ai_partner_write_intents

CREATE TABLE ai_partner_write_intents (
  intent_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY CHECK (length(intent_id) = 36),
  owner_telegram_id INTEGER NOT NULL
    REFERENCES users(telegram_id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  action_type TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (action_type IN (
    'save_own_draft', 'save_own_draft_version'
  )),
  target_draft_id TEXT REFERENCES ai_drafts(draft_id),
  request_key TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(request_key) BETWEEN 16 AND 160),
  payload_hash TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(payload_hash) = 64),
  confirmation_token_hash TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE
    CHECK (length(confirmation_token_hash) = 64),
  intent_state TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending' CHECK (intent_state IN (
    'pending', 'consumed', 'cancelled', 'expired'
  )),
  issued_at INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (issued_at > 0),
  expires_at INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (
    expires_at BETWEEN issued_at + 60 AND issued_at + 600
  ),
  resolved_at INTEGER,
  revision INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK (revision > 0),
  UNIQUE (owner_telegram_id, action_type, request_key),
  CHECK (
    (action_type = 'save_own_draft' AND target_draft_id IS NULL)
    OR (action_type = 'save_own_draft_version' AND target_draft_id IS NOT NULL)
  ),
  CHECK (
    (intent_state = 'pending' AND resolved_at IS NULL)
    OR (intent_state != 'pending' AND resolved_at IS NOT NULL
      AND resolved_at >= issued_at)
  ),
  CHECK (intent_state != 'consumed' OR resolved_at < expires_at),
  CHECK (intent_state != 'expired' OR resolved_at >= expires_at)
)

    'telegram_post', 'private_message', 'short_card', 'promotion_idea',
    'short_video_script', 'offer_explanation'
  )),

  fact_source_ids_json TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (
    json_valid(fact_source_ids_json)
    AND json_type(fact_source_ids_json) = 'array'
    AND json_array_length(fact_source_ids_json) BETWEEN 1 AND 32
  ),
  template_json TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (
    json_valid(template_json)
    AND json_type(template_json) = 'object'
    AND length(template_json) BETWEEN 20 AND 12000
  ),
  preview_hash TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(preview_hash) = 64),
  prepared_at INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (prepared_at > 0)
)

objects.name: ambassador_campaign_transitions
objects.sql:
CREATE TABLE ambassador_campaign_transitions (
  transition_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY CHECK (
    length(transition_id) = 36 AND transition_id = lower(transition_id)
  ),
  transition_key TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE CHECK (
    length(transition_key) = 64
    AND transition_key = lower(transition_key)
    AND transition_key NOT GLOB '*[^0-9a-f]*'
  ),
  campaign_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES ambassador_campaigns(campaign_id)
    ON UPDATE RESTRICT ON DELETE RESTRICT,
  campaign_revision INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (campaign_revision >= 2),
  from_status TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (from_status IN (
    'draft', 'active', 'paused'
  )),
  to_status TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (to_status IN (
    'active', 'paused', 'archived'
  )),
  reason_code TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (reason_code IN (
    'activation_approved', 'owner_paused', 'admin_paused',
    'owner_resumed', 'admin_resumed', 'period_ended', 'admin_archived'
  )),
  actor_kind TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (actor_kind IN (
    'ambassador', 'admin', 'system'
  )),
  evidence_hash TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (
    length(evidence_hash) = 64
    AND evidence_hash = lower(evidence_hash)
    AND evidence_hash NOT GLOB '*[^0-9a-f]*'
  ),
  occurred_at INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (occurred_at > 0),
  created_at INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (created_at >= occurred_at),
  UNIQUE (campaign_id, campaign_revision),
  CHECK (from_status != to_status),
  CHECK (
    (from_status = 'draft' AND to_status = 'active'
      AND reason_code = 'activation_approved'
      AND actor_kind IN ('admin', 'system'))
    OR (from_status = 'active' AND to_status = 'paused'
      AND reason_code IN ('owner_paused', 'admin_paused'))
    OR (from_status = 'paused' AND to_status = 'active'
      AND reason_code IN ('owner_resumed', 'admin_resumed'))
    OR (to_status = 'archived'
      AND reason_code IN ('period_ended', 'admin_archived'))
  ),
  CHECK (
    (reason_code IN ('owner_paused', 'owner_resumed')
      AND actor_kind = 'ambassador')
    OR (reason_code IN ('admin_paused', 'admin_resumed', 'admin_archived')
      AND actor_kind = 'admin')
    OR (reason_code = 'activation_approved'
      AND actor_kind IN ('admin', 'system'))
    OR (reason_code = 'period_ended' AND actor_kind = 'system')
  )
)

CREATE TABLE ambassador_campaigns (
  campaign_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY CHECK (
    length(campaign_id) = 36 AND campaign_id = lower(campaign_id)
  ),
  ambassador_id TEXT NOT NULL
    REFERENCES ambassador_profiles_v2(ambassador_id)
    ON UPDATE RESTRICT ON DELETE RESTRICT,
  scope_kind TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (scope_kind IN ('program', 'offer')),
  program_code TEXT NOT NULL
    REFERENCES partner_programs(code) ON UPDATE RESTRICT ON DELETE RESTRICT,
  catalog_offer_id INTEGER
    REFERENCES program_offers(id) ON UPDATE RESTRICT ON DELETE RESTRICT,
  status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'draft' CHECK (status IN (
    'draft', 'active', 'paused', 'archived'
  )),
  scope_evidence_hash TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (
    length(scope_evidence_hash) = 64
    AND scope_evidence_hash = lower(scope_evidence_hash)
    AND scope_evidence_hash NOT GLOB '*[^0-9a-f]*'
  ),
  starts_at INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (starts_at > 0),
  ends_at INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (ends_at > starts_at),
  revision INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK (revision > 0),
  activated_at INTEGER CHECK (activated_at IS NULL OR activated_at > 0),
  created_at INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (created_at > 0),
  updated_at INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (updated_at >= created_at),
  CHECK (
    (scope_kind = 'program' AND catalog_offer_id IS NULL)
    OR (scope_kind = 'offer' AND catalog_offer_id IS NOT NULL)
  ),
  CHECK (
    (status = 'draft' AND activated_at IS NULL)
    OR (status IN ('active', 'paused') AND activated_at IS NOT NULL)
    OR status = 'archived'
  ),
  UNIQUE (ambassador_id, program_code, catalog_offer_id, starts_at)
)

objects.name: ambassador_metrics_daily
objects.sql:
CREATE TABLE ambassador_metrics_daily (
  snapshot_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES analytics_projection_snapshots(snapshot_id)
    ON UPDATE RESTRICT ON DELETE RESTRICT,
  metric_date INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (
    metric_date > 0 AND metric_date % 86400 = 0
  ),
  ambassador_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES ambassador_profiles_v2(ambassador_id)
    ON UPDATE RESTRICT ON DELETE RESTRICT,
  scope_kind TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (scope_kind IN (
    'ambassador', 'campaign', 'program', 'offer'
  )),
  scope_hash TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (
    length(scope_hash) = 64
    AND scope_hash = lower(scope_hash)
    AND scope_hash NOT GLOB '*[^0-9a-f]*'
  ),
  campaign_id TEXT REFERENCES ambassador_campaigns(campaign_id)
    ON UPDATE RESTRICT ON DELETE RESTRICT,
  program_code TEXT,
  catalog_offer_id INTEGER,
  metric_key TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES analytics_metric_dictionary(metric_key)
    ON UPDATE RESTRICT ON DELETE RESTRICT,
  metric_count INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (metric_count >= 0),
  unique_actors INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (unique_actors >= 0),
  small_cell_threshold INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (
    small_cell_threshold BETWEEN 5 AND 20
  ),
  suppressed INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (suppressed IN (0, 1)),
  row_hash TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (
    length(row_hash) = 64
    AND row_hash = lower(row_hash)
    AND row_hash NOT GLOB '*[^0-9a-f]*'
  ),
  created_at INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (created_at > 0),
  PRIMARY KEY (
    snapshot_id, metric_date, ambassador_id, scope_kind, scope_hash, metric_key
  ),
  CHECK (
    (scope_kind = 'ambassador' AND campaign_id IS NULL
      AND program_code IS NULL AND catalog_offer_id IS NULL)
    OR (scope_kind = 'campaign' AND campaign_id IS NOT NULL
      AND program_code IS NULL AND catalog_offer_id IS NULL)
    OR (scope_kind = 'program' AND campaign_id IS NULL
      AND program_code IS NOT NULL AND catalog_offer_id IS NULL)
    OR (scope_kind = 'offer' AND campaign_id IS NULL
      AND program_code IS NOT NULL AND catalog_offer_id IS NOT NULL)
  ),
  CHECK (
    (suppressed = 1 AND unique_actors < small_cell_threshold)
    OR (suppressed = 0 AND unique_actors >= small_cell_threshold)
  )
)

objects.name: ambassador_profile_transitions

CREATE TABLE ambassador_profile_transitions (
  transition_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY CHECK (
    length(transition_id) = 36 AND transition_id = lower(transition_id)
  ),
  transition_key TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE CHECK (
    length(transition_key) = 64
    AND transition_key = lower(transition_key)
    AND transition_key NOT GLOB '*[^0-9a-f]*'
  ),
  ambassador_id TEXT NOT NULL
    REFERENCES ambassador_profiles_v2(ambassador_id)
    ON UPDATE RESTRICT ON DELETE RESTRICT,
  profile_revision INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (profile_revision >= 2),
  from_status TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (from_status IN (
    'draft', 'active', 'paused', 'suspended'
  )),
  to_status TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (to_status IN (
    'active', 'paused', 'suspended', 'archived'
  )),
  reason_code TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (reason_code IN (
    'activation_approved', 'admin_paused', 'admin_resumed',
    'moderation_suspended', 'eligibility_expired',
    'eligibility_restored', 'admin_archived'
  )),
  actor_kind TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (actor_kind IN ('admin', 'system')),
  evidence_hash TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (
    length(evidence_hash) = 64
    AND evidence_hash = lower(evidence_hash)
    AND evidence_hash NOT GLOB '*[^0-9a-f]*'
  ),
  occurred_at INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (occurred_at > 0),
  created_at INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (created_at >= occurred_at),
  UNIQUE (ambassador_id, profile_revision),
  CHECK (from_status != to_status),
  CHECK (
    (from_status = 'draft' AND to_status = 'active'
      AND reason_code = 'activation_approved')
    OR (from_status = 'active' AND to_status = 'paused'
      AND reason_code = 'admin_paused')
    OR (from_status = 'paused' AND to_status = 'active'
      AND reason_code = 'admin_resumed')
    OR (from_status IN ('active', 'paused') AND to_status = 'suspended'
      AND reason_code IN ('moderation_suspended', 'eligibility_expired'))
    OR (from_status = 'suspended' AND to_status = 'active'
      AND reason_code = 'eligibility_restored')
    OR (to_status = 'archived' AND reason_code = 'admin_archived')
  ),
  CHECK (
    (reason_code IN ('activation_approved', 'moderation_suspended',
      'eligibility_expired', 'eligibility_restored')
      AND actor_kind IN ('admin', 'system'))
    OR (reason_code IN ('admin_paused', 'admin_resumed', 'admin_archived')
      AND actor_kind = 'admin')
  )
)

    length(decision_key) = 64

  ),
  actor_pseudonym TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (
    length(actor_pseudonym) = 64
    AND actor_pseudonym = lower(actor_pseudonym)
    AND actor_pseudonym NOT GLOB '*[^0-9a-f]*'
  ),
  pseudonym_key_version INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (pseudonym_key_version > 0),
  attribution_kind TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (attribution_kind IN (
    'relationship', 'engagement', 'commercial'
  )),
  outcome TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (outcome IN (
    'attributed', 'unattributed', 'rejected'
  )),
  ambassador_id TEXT REFERENCES ambassador_profiles_v2(ambassador_id)
    ON UPDATE RESTRICT ON DELETE RESTRICT,
  campaign_id TEXT REFERENCES ambassador_campaigns(campaign_id)
    ON UPDATE RESTRICT ON DELETE RESTRICT,
  touchpoint_id TEXT REFERENCES analytics_attribution_touchpoints(touchpoint_id)
    ON UPDATE RESTRICT ON DELETE RESTRICT,
  authority_kind TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (authority_kind IN (
    'first_inviter', 'verified_touchpoint', 'lead_partner_attribution',
    'stars_access', 'referral_reward'
  )),
  authority_evidence_hash TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (
    length(authority_evidence_hash) = 64
    AND authority_evidence_hash = lower(authority_evidence_hash)
    AND authority_evidence_hash NOT GLOB '*[^0-9a-f]*'
  ),
  reason_code TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (reason_code IN (
    'attributed_exact', 'no_exact_evidence', 'self_attribution',
    'owner_mismatch', 'cycle_detected', 'campaign_inactive',
    'campaign_expired', 'window_expired', 'source_unknown',
    'authority_status_invalid'
  )),
  model_version INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK (model_version = 1),
  occurred_at INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (occurred_at > 0),
  decided_at INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (decided_at >= occurred_at),
  retention_until INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (
    retention_until >= decided_at
    AND retention_until <= decided_at + 15552000
  ),
  CHECK (
    (attribution_kind = 'relationship'
      AND authority_kind = 'first_inviter'
      AND campaign_id IS NULL AND touchpoint_id IS NULL)
    OR (attribution_kind = 'engagement'
      AND authority_kind = 'verified_touchpoint')
    OR (attribution_kind = 'commercial'
      AND authority_kind IN (
        'lead_partner_attribution', 'stars_access', 'referral_reward'
      ))
  ),
  CHECK (
    (outcome = 'attributed' AND ambassador_id IS NOT NULL
      AND reason_code = 'attributed_exact')
    OR (outcome != 'attributed' AND reason_code != 'attributed_exact')
  ),
  CHECK (
    attribution_kind != 'engagement'
    OR outcome != 'attributed'
    OR (campaign_id IS NOT NULL AND touchpoint_id IS NOT NULL)
  ),
  CHECK (
    attribution_kind != 'commercial'
    OR outcome != 'attributed'
    OR campaign_id IS NOT NULL
  )
)

  activity_date INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (
    activity_date = cohort_date + offset_days * 86400

  retained_actors INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (
    retained_actors >= 0 AND retained_actors <= cohort_size
  ),

    retention_bps IS NULL OR retention_bps BETWEEN 0 AND 10000
  ),

  CHECK (eligible = 1 OR (retained_actors = 0 AND retention_bps IS NULL)),
  CHECK (
    retention_bps IS NULL
    OR (eligible = 1 AND cohort_size > 0 AND suppressed = 0)
  ),
  CHECK (
    (suppressed = 1 AND cohort_size < small_cell_threshold)
    OR (suppressed = 0 AND cohort_size >= small_cell_threshold)

objects.name: analytics_ingestion_receipts
objects.sql:
CREATE TABLE analytics_ingestion_receipts (
  receipt_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY CHECK (
    length(receipt_id) = 36 AND receipt_id = lower(receipt_id)
  ),
  batch_fingerprint TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (
    length(batch_fingerprint) = 64
    AND batch_fingerprint = lower(batch_fingerprint)
    AND batch_fingerprint NOT GLOB '*[^0-9a-f]*'
  ),
  source_kind TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (source_kind IN (
    'users', 'terms', 'bot_start', 'legacy_funnel', 'partner_program',
    'partner_link', 'lead', 'stars_payment', 'stars_access',
    'referral_reward', 'ai_partner'
  )),
  origin TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (origin IN (
    'live', 'backfill', 'reconciliation'
  )),
  high_watermark_at INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (high_watermark_at > 0),
  cursor_hash TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (
    length(cursor_hash) = 64
    AND cursor_hash = lower(cursor_hash)
    AND cursor_hash NOT GLOB '*[^0-9a-f]*'
  ),
  checkpoint_revision INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (checkpoint_revision >= 2),
  checkpoint_rows_seen INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (checkpoint_rows_seen >= 0),
  checkpoint_rows_inserted INTEGER NOT NULL
    CHECK (checkpoint_rows_inserted >= 0),
  checkpoint_rows_duplicate INTEGER NOT NULL
    CHECK (checkpoint_rows_duplicate >= 0),
  checkpoint_rows_conflict INTEGER NOT NULL
    CHECK (checkpoint_rows_conflict >= 0),
  attempt_count INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (attempt_count BETWEEN 1 AND 2),
  max_rows INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (max_rows BETWEEN 1 AND 100),
  rows_seen INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (
    rows_seen BETWEEN 0 AND max_rows
  ),
  rows_inserted INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (rows_inserted >= 0),
  rows_duplicate INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (rows_duplicate >= 0),
  rows_conflict INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (rows_conflict >= 0),
  rows_unmapped INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (rows_unmapped >= 0),
  rows_invalid INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (rows_invalid >= 0),
  rows_ambiguous INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (rows_ambiguous >= 0),
  rows_excluded INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (rows_excluded >= 0),
  input_digest TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (
    length(input_digest) = 64
    AND input_digest = lower(input_digest)
    AND input_digest NOT GLOB '*[^0-9a-f]*'
  ),
  result_digest TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (
    length(result_digest) = 64
    AND result_digest = lower(result_digest)
    AND result_digest NOT GLOB '*[^0-9a-f]*'
  ),
  status TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (status IN ('complete', 'partial')),
  started_at INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (started_at > 0),
  finished_at INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (finished_at >= started_at),
  retention_until INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (
    retention_until >= finished_at
    AND retention_until <= finished_at + 15552000
  ),
  CHECK (
    rows_seen = rows_inserted + rows_duplicate + rows_conflict
      + rows_unmapped + rows_invalid + rows_ambiguous + rows_excluded
  ),
  CHECK (
    (status = 'complete'
      AND rows_conflict = 0
      AND rows_unmapped = 0
      AND rows_invalid = 0
      AND rows_ambiguous = 0)
    OR status = 'partial'
  )
)

  ),

  )),

    CHECK (object_dimension_name = 'object_type'),
  object_type TEXT,
  reason_code TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (reason_code IN (
    'mapped_exact', 'authoritative_source_elsewhere',
    'not_in_v1_registry', 'semantics_not_exact'
  )),
  mapping_version INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK (mapping_version = 1),
  policy_version TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (
    policy_version = '2026-09-13.analytics-v2-part2'
  ),

    REFERENCES analytics_event_registry(event_name, event_version)
    ON UPDATE RESTRICT ON DELETE RESTRICT,

    REFERENCES analytics_dimension_registry(dimension_name, dimension_value)
    ON UPDATE RESTRICT ON DELETE RESTRICT,

      AND canonical_event_name IS NOT NULL

      AND reason_code = 'mapped_exact')
    OR

objects.name: analytics_release_source_evidence
objects.sql:
CREATE TABLE analytics_release_source_evidence (
  run_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES analytics_release_runs(run_id)
    ON UPDATE RESTRICT ON DELETE CASCADE,
  source_kind TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (source_kind IN (
    'users', 'terms', 'bot_start', 'legacy_funnel', 'partner_program',
    'partner_link', 'lead', 'stars_payment', 'stars_access',
    'referral_reward', 'ai_partner'
  )),
  source_order INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (source_order BETWEEN 1 AND 11),
  high_watermark_at INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (high_watermark_at > 0),
  rows_seen INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (rows_seen BETWEEN 0 AND 100),
  rows_inserted INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (rows_inserted BETWEEN 0 AND rows_seen),
  rows_duplicate INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (rows_duplicate BETWEEN 0 AND rows_seen),
  rows_conflict INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (rows_conflict BETWEEN 0 AND rows_seen),
  rows_unmapped INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (rows_unmapped BETWEEN 0 AND rows_seen),
  rows_invalid INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (rows_invalid BETWEEN 0 AND rows_seen),
  rows_ambiguous INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (rows_ambiguous BETWEEN 0 AND rows_seen),
  rows_excluded INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (rows_excluded BETWEEN 0 AND rows_seen),
  rows_accounted INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (rows_accounted = rows_seen),
  canonical_expected INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (
    canonical_expected = rows_inserted + rows_duplicate
  ),
  outcome TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (outcome IN (
    'complete', 'blocked'
  )),
  input_digest TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (
    length(input_digest) = 64
    AND input_digest = lower(input_digest)
    AND input_digest NOT GLOB '*[^0-9a-f]*'
  ),
  result_digest TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (
    length(result_digest) = 64
    AND result_digest = lower(result_digest)
    AND result_digest NOT GLOB '*[^0-9a-f]*'
  ),
  evidence_digest TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (
    length(evidence_digest) = 64
    AND evidence_digest = lower(evidence_digest)
    AND evidence_digest NOT GLOB '*[^0-9a-f]*'
  ),
  recorded_at INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (recorded_at >= high_watermark_at),
  retention_until INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (
    retention_until >= recorded_at
    AND retention_until <= recorded_at + 15552000
  ),
  policy_version TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (
    policy_version = '2026-09-13.analytics-v2-part6'
  ),
  PRIMARY KEY (run_id, source_kind),
  UNIQUE (run_id, source_order),
  CHECK (
    rows_seen = rows_inserted + rows_duplicate + rows_conflict
      + rows_unmapped + rows_invalid + rows_ambiguous + rows_excluded
  ),
  CHECK (
    (outcome = 'complete'
      AND rows_conflict = 0 AND rows_unmapped = 0
      AND rows_invalid = 0 AND rows_ambiguous = 0)
    OR outcome = 'blocked'
  )
)

CREATE TABLE analytics_release_stage_evidence (

  stage_kind TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (stage_kind IN (
    'backup', 'restore', 'schema', 'source_snapshot', 'ingestion',
    'projection', 'reconciliation', 'runtime_regression', 'disable'
  )),
  outcome TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (outcome IN ('passed', 'blocked', 'skipped')),
  reason_code TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (reason_code IN (
    'none', 'not_applicable', 'backup_missing', 'restore_failed',
    'schema_mismatch', 'source_changed', 'source_partial',
    'unexplained_delta', 'scope_leak', 'runtime_regression',
    'operator_disabled'
  )),
  observed_count INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (observed_count >= 0),
  expected_count INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (expected_count >= 0),
  unexplained_delta INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  evidence_digest TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (
    length(evidence_digest) = 64
    AND evidence_digest = lower(evidence_digest)
    AND evidence_digest NOT GLOB '*[^0-9a-f]*'
  ),
  recorded_at INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (recorded_at > 0),
  retention_until INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (
    retention_until >= recorded_at
    AND retention_until <= recorded_at + 15552000
  ),
  policy_version TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (
    policy_version = '2026-09-13.analytics-v2-part6'
  ),
  PRIMARY KEY (run_id, stage_order),
  UNIQUE (run_id, stage_kind),
  CHECK (
    (outcome = 'passed' AND reason_code = 'none' AND unexplained_delta = 0)
    OR (outcome = 'skipped' AND reason_code IN (
      'not_applicable', 'operator_disabled'
    ))
    OR outcome = 'blocked'
  )
)

  )),

    'off', 'ready', 'running', 'paused', 'complete', 'failed'
  )),
  cursor_hash TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '' CHECK (
    cursor_hash = ''
    OR (
      length(cursor_hash) = 64
      AND cursor_hash = lower(cursor_hash)
      AND cursor_hash NOT GLOB '*[^0-9a-f]*'
    )
  ),
  high_watermark_at INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (high_watermark_at >= 0),
  rows_seen INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (rows_seen >= 0),
  rows_inserted INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (
    rows_inserted >= 0 AND rows_inserted <= rows_seen
  ),
  rows_duplicate INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (
    rows_duplicate >= 0 AND rows_duplicate <= rows_seen
  ),
  rows_conflict INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (
    rows_conflict >= 0 AND rows_conflict <= rows_seen
  ),
  last_error_code TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '' CHECK (length(last_error_code) <= 80),
  revision INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK (revision > 0),
  created_at INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (created_at > 0),
  updated_at INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (updated_at >= created_at),
  CHECK (
    (status = 'off' AND cursor_hash = '' AND high_watermark_at = 0
      AND rows_seen = 0 AND rows_inserted = 0
      AND rows_duplicate = 0 AND rows_conflict = 0
      AND last_error_code = '')
    OR status != 'off'
  ),
  CHECK (
    (status = 'failed' AND length(last_error_code) BETWEEN 3 AND 80)
    OR (status != 'failed' AND last_error_code = '')
  )
)

CREATE TABLE bonus_access_effects (

    'none', 'trial', 'active', 'cancel_at_period_end', 'expired',
    'refunded', 'suspended'
  )),
  prior_plan_revision INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (prior_plan_revision > 0),
  result_plan_revision INTEGER NOT NULL
    CHECK (result_plan_revision = prior_plan_revision + 1),
  prior_access_revision INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (prior_access_revision > 0),
  result_access_revision INTEGER NOT NULL
    CHECK (result_access_revision = prior_access_revision + 1),
  target_subscription_id TEXT REFERENCES subscriptions(subscription_id),

  result_subscription_revision INTEGER,
  source_payment_ledger_entry_id TEXT NOT NULL
    REFERENCES payment_ledger(ledger_entry_id),
  applied_transition_id TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE
    REFERENCES referral_reward_transitions(transition_id),
  effect_starts_at INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (effect_starts_at > 0),
  effect_ends_at INTEGER NOT NULL
    CHECK (effect_ends_at = effect_starts_at + 259200),
  recorded_at INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (recorded_at > 0),
  CHECK (
    (effect_kind = 'manual_professional_access'
      AND plan_code = 'professional'
      AND prior_plan_code = 'free'
      AND prior_access_state IN ('none', 'trial', 'expired', 'refunded')
      AND target_subscription_id IS NULL
      AND prior_subscription_revision IS NULL
      AND result_subscription_revision IS NULL
      AND recorded_at = effect_starts_at)
    OR
    (effect_kind = 'paid_plan_extension'
      AND prior_plan_code = plan_code
      AND prior_access_state IN ('active', 'cancel_at_period_end')
      AND target_subscription_id IS NOT NULL
      AND prior_subscription_revision IS NOT NULL
      AND prior_subscription_revision > 0
      AND result_subscription_revision = prior_subscription_revision + 1
      AND recorded_at <= effect_starts_at)
  )
)

objects.name: bonus_access_grants
objects.sql:
CREATE TABLE bonus_access_grants (
  bonus_grant_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY CHECK (length(bonus_grant_id) = 36),
  grant_key TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE CHECK (length(grant_key) BETWEEN 16 AND 160),
  reward_id TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE REFERENCES referral_rewards(reward_id),
  program_code TEXT NOT NULL
    CHECK (program_code = 'first_paid_friend_v1'),
  beneficiary_telegram_id INTEGER NOT NULL
    CHECK (beneficiary_telegram_id > 0),
  delivery_mode TEXT NOT NULL
    CHECK (delivery_mode IN ('manual_claim', 'extend_active_plan')),
  plan_code TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (plan_code IN ('professional', 'dragon')),
  bonus_seconds INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (bonus_seconds = 259200),
  grant_status TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (grant_status IN (
    'pending', 'claimable', 'applied', 'expired', 'revoked', 'manual_review'
  )),
  available_at INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (available_at > 0),
  claim_expires_at INTEGER,
  claimed_at INTEGER,
  applied_at INTEGER,
  starts_at INTEGER,
  ends_at INTEGER,
  target_subscription_id TEXT REFERENCES subscriptions(subscription_id),
  compensation_ledger_entry_id TEXT UNIQUE
    REFERENCES payment_ledger(ledger_entry_id),
  compensated_seconds INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0
    CHECK (compensated_seconds BETWEEN 0 AND 259200),
  compensated_at INTEGER,
  last_transition_id TEXT,
  revision INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK (revision > 0),
  created_at INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (created_at >= available_at),
  updated_at INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (updated_at >= created_at),
  CHECK (
    (delivery_mode = 'manual_claim'
      AND plan_code = 'professional'
      AND claim_expires_at IS NOT NULL
      AND claim_expires_at = available_at + 2592000
      AND target_subscription_id IS NULL
      AND grant_status IN (
        'claimable', 'applied', 'expired', 'revoked', 'manual_review'
      ))
    OR
    (delivery_mode = 'extend_active_plan'
      AND claim_expires_at IS NULL
      AND target_subscription_id IS NOT NULL
      AND grant_status IN ('pending', 'applied', 'revoked', 'manual_review'))
  ),
  CHECK (
    (grant_status IN ('pending', 'claimable', 'expired')
      AND claimed_at IS NULL AND applied_at IS NULL
      AND starts_at IS NULL AND ends_at IS NULL)
    OR
    (grant_status IN ('applied', 'manual_review')
      AND applied_at IS NOT NULL AND applied_at >= available_at
      AND starts_at IS NOT NULL AND starts_at >= available_at
      AND ends_at IS NOT NULL
      AND ends_at = starts_at + bonus_seconds
      AND (
        (delivery_mode = 'manual_claim'
          AND claimed_at IS NOT NULL
          AND claimed_at BETWEEN available_at AND claim_expires_at
          AND applied_at >= claimed_at)
        OR
        (delivery_mode = 'extend_active_plan' AND claimed_at IS NULL)
      ))
    OR
    (grant_status = 'revoked' AND (
      (claimed_at IS NULL AND applied_at IS NULL
        AND starts_at IS NULL AND ends_at IS NULL)
      OR
      (applied_at IS NOT NULL AND starts_at IS NOT NULL
        AND ends_at IS NOT NULL
        AND ends_at = starts_at + bonus_seconds)
    ))
  ),
  CHECK (
    (compensation_ledger_entry_id IS NULL
      AND compensated_seconds = 0 AND compensated_at IS NULL)
    OR
    (compensation_ledger_entry_id IS NOT NULL
      AND compensated_at IS NOT NULL AND compensated_at >= available_at)
  ),
  CHECK (grant_status != 'manual_review'
    OR compensation_ledger_entry_id IS NOT NULL)
)

objects.sql:
CREATE TABLE bonus_access_reversals (
  reversal_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY CHECK (length(reversal_id) = 36),
  reversal_key TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE
    CHECK (length(reversal_key) BETWEEN 16 AND 160),
  effect_id TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE REFERENCES bonus_access_effects(effect_id),

    REFERENCES payment_ledger(ledger_entry_id),
  beneficiary_telegram_id INTEGER NOT NULL
    CHECK (beneficiary_telegram_id > 0),
  reversal_kind TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (reversal_kind IN (
    'manual_access_removed', 'paid_extension_removed'
  )),
  removed_seconds INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (removed_seconds = 259200),
  prior_plan_revision INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (prior_plan_revision > 0),
  result_plan_revision INTEGER NOT NULL
    CHECK (result_plan_revision = prior_plan_revision + 1),
  prior_access_revision INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (prior_access_revision > 0),
  result_access_revision INTEGER NOT NULL
    CHECK (result_access_revision = prior_access_revision + 1),
  target_subscription_id TEXT REFERENCES subscriptions(subscription_id),
  prior_subscription_revision INTEGER,
  result_subscription_revision INTEGER,
  access_would_start_at INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (access_would_start_at > 0),
  access_would_end_at INTEGER NOT NULL
    CHECK (access_would_end_at = access_would_start_at + removed_seconds),
  compensation_occurred_at INTEGER NOT NULL
    CHECK (compensation_occurred_at > 0),
  recorded_at INTEGER NOT NULL
    CHECK (recorded_at >= compensation_occurred_at),
  CHECK (recorded_at <= access_would_start_at),
  CHECK (
    (reversal_kind = 'manual_access_removed'
      AND target_subscription_id IS NULL
      AND prior_subscription_revision IS NULL
      AND result_subscription_revision IS NULL)
    OR
    (reversal_kind = 'paid_extension_removed'
      AND target_subscription_id IS NOT NULL
      AND prior_subscription_revision IS NOT NULL
      AND prior_subscription_revision > 0
      AND result_subscription_revision = prior_subscription_revision + 1)
  )
)

    AND authority_key_hash = lower(authority_key_hash)
    AND authority_key_hash NOT GLOB '*[^0-9a-f]*'
  ),
  idempotency_key TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE CHECK (
    length(idempotency_key) = 68
    AND substr(idempotency_key, 1, 4) = 'key_'
    AND substr(idempotency_key, 5) NOT GLOB '*[^0-9a-f]*'
  ),
  request_hash TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (
    length(request_hash) = 64 AND request_hash = lower(request_hash)
    AND request_hash NOT GLOB '*[^0-9a-f]*'
  ),
  created_at INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (created_at > 0),
  valid_until INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (
    valid_until > created_at AND valid_until <= created_at + 300
  ),

    retention_until >= valid_until
    AND retention_until <= created_at + 15552000
  ),
  FOREIGN KEY (subject_telegram_id) REFERENCES user_plans(telegram_id)

      AND base_plan_code = 'free' AND plan_code = 'free'
      AND access_state IN ('none', 'expired', 'refunded')
      AND source_ends_at IS NULL
      AND subscription_id IS NULL AND access_grant_id IS NULL
      AND trial_grant_id IS NULL)
    OR
    (source_kind = 'dragon_preview'
      AND base_plan_code = 'free' AND plan_code = 'dragon'
      AND access_state = 'trial'
      AND source_ends_at = source_starts_at + 604800
      AND subscription_id IS NULL AND access_grant_id IS NULL
      AND trial_grant_id IS NOT NULL)
    OR
    (source_kind = 'stars_subscription'
      AND base_plan_code = plan_code
      AND plan_code IN ('professional', 'dragon')
      AND access_state IN ('active', 'cancel_at_period_end')
      AND source_ends_at IS NOT NULL
      AND subscription_id IS NOT NULL AND access_grant_id IS NOT NULL
      AND trial_grant_id IS NULL)
  ),
  CHECK (
    (plan_code = 'free' AND capacity_percent = 10
      AND active_application_limit = 5)
    OR (plan_code = 'professional' AND capacity_percent = 50
      AND active_application_limit = 25)
    OR (plan_code = 'dragon' AND capacity_percent = 100
      AND active_application_limit = 50)
  )
)

objects.sql:
CREATE TABLE cabinet_application_events (
  event_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY CHECK (
    length(event_id) = 68
    AND substr(event_id, 1, 4) = 'aev_'
    AND substr(event_id, 5) NOT GLOB '*[^0-9a-f]*'
  ),
  application_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES cabinet_applications(application_id)
    ON UPDATE RESTRICT ON DELETE RESTRICT,
  event_kind TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (event_kind IN (
    'created', 'status_changed', 'note_added',
    'assignment_changed', 'result_recorded'
  )),
  status_from TEXT,
  status_to TEXT,
  actor_role TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (actor_role IN ('user', 'partner', 'admin')),
  action_source TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (
    action_source IN ('mini_app', 'worker', 'admin', 'system')
  ),
  actor_key_hash TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (
    length(actor_key_hash) = 64 AND actor_key_hash = lower(actor_key_hash)
    AND actor_key_hash NOT GLOB '*[^0-9a-f]*'
  ),
  data_hash TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (
    length(data_hash) = 64 AND data_hash = lower(data_hash)
    AND data_hash NOT GLOB '*[^0-9a-f]*'
  ),
  request_hash TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (
    length(request_hash) = 64 AND request_hash = lower(request_hash)
    AND request_hash NOT GLOB '*[^0-9a-f]*'
  ),
  revision_before INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (revision_before >= 0),
  revision_after INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (revision_after >= revision_before),
  idempotency_key TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE CHECK (
    length(idempotency_key) = 68
    AND substr(idempotency_key, 1, 4) = 'key_'
    AND substr(idempotency_key, 5) NOT GLOB '*[^0-9a-f]*'
  ),
  occurred_at INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (occurred_at > 0),
  CHECK (
    (event_kind = 'created' AND status_from IS NULL AND status_to = 'submitted'
      AND revision_before = 0 AND revision_after = 1)
    OR
    (event_kind = 'status_changed' AND status_from IS NOT NULL
      AND status_to IS NOT NULL AND status_from != status_to
      AND revision_after = revision_before + 1)
    OR
    (event_kind IN ('note_added', 'assignment_changed', 'result_recorded')
      AND status_from IS NULL AND status_to IS NULL)
  ),
  CHECK (
    (actor_role IN ('user', 'partner')
      AND action_source IN ('mini_app', 'worker'))
    OR (actor_role = 'admin'
      AND action_source IN ('admin', 'worker', 'system'))
  )
)

  result_hash TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (
    length(result_hash) = 64 AND result_hash = lower(result_hash)
    AND result_hash NOT GLOB '*[^0-9a-f]*'
  ),
  idempotency_key TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE CHECK (
    length(idempotency_key) = 68
    AND substr(idempotency_key, 1, 4) = 'key_'
    AND substr(idempotency_key, 5) NOT GLOB '*[^0-9a-f]*'
  ),
  request_hash TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (
    length(request_hash) = 64 AND request_hash = lower(request_hash)
    AND request_hash NOT GLOB '*[^0-9a-f]*'
  ),
  before_hash TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (
    length(before_hash) = 64 AND before_hash = lower(before_hash)
    AND before_hash NOT GLOB '*[^0-9a-f]*'
  ),
  after_hash TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (
    length(after_hash) = 64 AND after_hash = lower(after_hash)
    AND after_hash NOT GLOB '*[^0-9a-f]*'
  ),
  occurred_at INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (occurred_at > 0),
  CHECK (
    (terminal_status = 'completed' AND result_code = 'successful')
    OR (terminal_status = 'rejected' AND result_code = 'unsuccessful')
    OR (terminal_status = 'cancelled' AND result_code = 'cancelled')
  ),
  CHECK (before_hash != after_hash),
  CHECK (
    (actor_role = 'partner' AND action_source IN ('mini_app', 'worker'))
    OR (actor_role = 'admin'
      AND action_source IN ('admin', 'worker', 'system'))
  )
)

CREATE TABLE cabinet_application_status_registry (

    'submitted', 'accepted', 'in_progress', 'waiting_user',
    'completed', 'rejected', 'cancelled', 'archived'
  )),
  contract_version INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK (contract_version = 1),
  active_slot INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (active_slot IN (0, 1)),
  terminal INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (terminal IN (0, 1)),
  sort_order INTEGER NOT NULL UNIQUE CHECK (sort_order BETWEEN 10 AND 80),
  created_at INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (created_at > 0),
  PRIMARY KEY (status_code, contract_version),
  CHECK (active_slot + terminal = 1),

      AND active_slot = 1 AND terminal = 0)
    OR
    (status_code IN ('completed', 'rejected', 'cancelled', 'archived')

  )
)

  ),

    AND request_hash NOT GLOB '*[^0-9a-f]*'
  ),

  CHECK (
    (scope_rule = 'resource' AND resource_id IS NOT NULL)
    OR (scope_rule != 'resource' AND resource_id IS NULL)
  )
)

    AND capability_code NOT GLOB '*[^a-z0-9._]*'
  ),

  created_at INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (created_at > 0),

    = resource_kind || '.'),
  UNIQUE (resource_kind, action)
)

  ),

  ),

    'home', 'profile', 'offers', 'applications', 'results',
    'application_detail'
  )),

    capability_code
  ) ON UPDATE RESTRICT ON DELETE RESTRICT,
  resource_kind TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (resource_kind IN (
    'profile', 'offer', 'application'
  )),
  recovery_safe INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (recovery_safe IN (0, 1)),
  route_registry_version INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1
    CHECK (route_registry_version = 1),
  policy_version TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '2026-09-14.cabinet-v1-part5'
    CHECK (policy_version = '2026-09-14.cabinet-v1-part5'),
  created_at INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (created_at > 0),
  CHECK (
    (screen_code IN ('home', 'profile')
      AND capability_code = 'profile.read' AND resource_kind = 'profile')
    OR (screen_code = 'offers'
      AND capability_code = 'offer.read' AND resource_kind = 'offer')
    OR (screen_code IN (
      'applications', 'results', 'application_detail'
    ) AND capability_code = 'application.read'
      AND resource_kind = 'application')
  ),
  CHECK (screen_code != 'application_detail' OR recovery_safe = 0)
)

    AND price_version_hash = lower(price_version_hash)
    AND price_version_hash NOT GLOB '*[^0-9a-f]*'
  ),
  currency TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (currency = 'XTR'),
  base_price_stars INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (base_price_stars > 0),
  discount_basis_points INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (
    discount_basis_points IN (0, 2000, 5000)
  ),
  discount_stars INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (discount_stars >= 0),
  final_price_stars INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (final_price_stars > 0),
  candidate_set_hash TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (
    length(candidate_set_hash) = 64
    AND candidate_set_hash = lower(candidate_set_hash)
    AND candidate_set_hash NOT GLOB '*[^0-9a-f]*'
  ),
  authority_hash TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (
    length(authority_hash) = 64
    AND authority_hash = lower(authority_hash)
    AND authority_hash NOT GLOB '*[^0-9a-f]*'
  ),
  idempotency_key TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE CHECK (
    length(idempotency_key) = 68
    AND substr(idempotency_key, 1, 4) = 'key_'
    AND substr(idempotency_key, 5) NOT GLOB '*[^0-9a-f]*'
  ),
  request_hash TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (
    length(request_hash) = 64
    AND request_hash = lower(request_hash)
    AND request_hash NOT GLOB '*[^0-9a-f]*'
  ),
  evaluated_at INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (evaluated_at > 0),
  retention_until INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (
    retention_until >= evaluated_at
    AND retention_until <= evaluated_at + 15552000
  ),
  CHECK (
    discount_stars = (base_price_stars * discount_basis_points) / 10000
    AND final_price_stars = base_price_stars - discount_stars
  ),
  CHECK (
    (outcome = 'eligible' AND reason_code = 'eligible'
      AND selected_policy_code IS NOT NULL
      AND promotion_window_id IS NOT NULL
      AND discount_basis_points IN (2000, 5000))
    OR
    (outcome = 'ineligible' AND reason_code != 'eligible'
      AND selected_policy_code IS NULL AND promotion_window_id IS NULL
      AND discount_basis_points = 0 AND discount_stars = 0
      AND final_price_stars = base_price_stars)
  )
)

CREATE TABLE cabinet_release_v1_runs (

    length(run_id) = 36 AND run_id = lower(run_id)
  ),
  action TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (action IN (
    'prepare_closed', 'enable_admin_shadow', 'disable'
  )),
  source_mode TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (source_mode IN ('none', 'synthetic')),
  requested_by_hash TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (
    length(requested_by_hash) = 64
    AND requested_by_hash = lower(requested_by_hash)
    AND requested_by_hash NOT GLOB '*[^0-9a-f]*'
  ),
  commit_sha TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (
    length(commit_sha) = 40
    AND commit_sha = lower(commit_sha)
    AND commit_sha NOT GLOB '*[^0-9a-f]*'
  ),
  manifest_digest TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (
    length(manifest_digest) = 64
    AND manifest_digest = lower(manifest_digest)
    AND manifest_digest NOT GLOB '*[^0-9a-f]*'
  ),
  plan_digest TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE CHECK (
    length(plan_digest) = 64
    AND plan_digest = lower(plan_digest)
    AND plan_digest NOT GLOB '*[^0-9a-f]*'
  ),
  expected_stage_count INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (expected_stage_count = 8),
  expected_canary_count INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (
    expected_canary_count = CASE
      WHEN action = 'enable_admin_shadow' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
  ),
  status TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (status IN ('complete', 'blocked')),
  created_at INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (created_at > 0),
  retention_until INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (
    retention_until >= created_at
    AND retention_until <= created_at + 15552000
  ),
  policy_version TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (
    policy_version = '2026-09-14.cabinet-v1-part6'
  ),
  CHECK (
    (action = 'enable_admin_shadow' AND source_mode = 'synthetic')
    OR (action != 'enable_admin_shadow' AND source_mode = 'none')
  )
)

objects.name: cabinet_release_v1_stage_evidence
objects.sql:
CREATE TABLE cabinet_release_v1_stage_evidence (
  run_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES cabinet_release_v1_runs(run_id)
    ON UPDATE RESTRICT ON DELETE RESTRICT,
  stage_order INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (stage_order BETWEEN 1 AND 8),
  stage_kind TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (stage_kind IN (
    'backup', 'restore', 'schema', 'stable_regression',
    'owner_scope', 'closed_canary', 'replay', 'rollback'
  )),
  outcome TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (outcome IN ('passed', 'blocked', 'skipped')),
  reason_code TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (reason_code IN (
    'none', 'not_applicable', 'backup_missing', 'restore_failed',
    'schema_mismatch', 'runtime_regression', 'scope_leak',
    'canary_mismatch', 'replay_mismatch', 'rollback_failed'
  )),
  observed_count INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (observed_count >= 0),
  expected_count INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (expected_count >= 0),
  unexplained_delta INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  evidence_digest TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (
    length(evidence_digest) = 64
    AND evidence_digest = lower(evidence_digest)
    AND evidence_digest NOT GLOB '*[^0-9a-f]*'
  ),
  recorded_at INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (recorded_at > 0),
  retention_until INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (
    retention_until >= recorded_at
    AND retention_until <= recorded_at + 15552000
  ),
  policy_version TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (
    policy_version = '2026-09-14.cabinet-v1-part6'
  ),
  PRIMARY KEY (run_id, stage_order),
  UNIQUE (run_id, stage_kind),
  CHECK (stage_order = CASE stage_kind
    WHEN 'backup' THEN 1
    WHEN 'restore' THEN 2
    WHEN 'schema' THEN 3
    WHEN 'stable_regression' THEN 4
    WHEN 'owner_scope' THEN 5
    WHEN 'closed_canary' THEN 6
    WHEN 'replay' THEN 7
    WHEN 'rollback' THEN 8
    ELSE 0 END),
  CHECK (
    (outcome = 'passed' AND reason_code = 'none'
      AND unexplained_delta = 0 AND observed_count = expected_count)
    OR (outcome = 'skipped' AND reason_code = 'not_applicable'
      AND unexplained_delta = 0)
    OR outcome = 'blocked'
  )
)

objects.sql:
CREATE TABLE canonical_analytics_events (
  event_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY CHECK (
    length(event_id) = 36 AND event_id = lower(event_id)
  ),
  event_key TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE CHECK (
    length(event_key) = 68
    AND substr(event_key, 1, 4) = 'evt_'
    AND substr(event_key, 5) NOT GLOB '*[^0-9a-f]*'
  ),
  event_name TEXT NOT NULL,
  event_version INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (event_version = 1),
  occurred_at INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (occurred_at > 0),
  recorded_at INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (recorded_at >= occurred_at),
  origin TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (origin IN (
    'live', 'backfill', 'reconciliation', 'system'
  )),
  actor_pseudonym TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (
    length(actor_pseudonym) = 64
    AND actor_pseudonym = lower(actor_pseudonym)
    AND actor_pseudonym NOT GLOB '*[^0-9a-f]*'
  ),
  pseudonym_key_version INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (pseudonym_key_version > 0),
  source_kind TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (source_kind IN (
    'users', 'terms', 'bot_start', 'legacy_funnel', 'partner_program',
    'partner_link', 'lead', 'stars_payment', 'stars_access',
    'referral_reward', 'ai_partner', 'analytics_system'
  )),
  source_key_hash TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (
    length(source_key_hash) = 64
    AND source_key_hash = lower(source_key_hash)
    AND source_key_hash NOT GLOB '*[^0-9a-f]*'
  ),
  payload_hash TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (
    length(payload_hash) = 64
    AND payload_hash = lower(payload_hash)
    AND payload_hash NOT GLOB '*[^0-9a-f]*'
  ),
  privacy_class TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (privacy_class = 'pseudonymous'),
  correction_kind TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'none'
    CHECK (correction_kind IN ('none', 'retract', 'replace')),
  correction_of_event_key_hash TEXT CHECK (
    correction_of_event_key_hash IS NULL
    OR (
      length(correction_of_event_key_hash) = 64
      AND correction_of_event_key_hash = lower(correction_of_event_key_hash)
      AND correction_of_event_key_hash NOT GLOB '*[^0-9a-f]*'
    )
  ),
  replacement_event_key_hash TEXT CHECK (
    replacement_event_key_hash IS NULL
    OR (
      length(replacement_event_key_hash) = 64
      AND replacement_event_key_hash = lower(replacement_event_key_hash)
      AND replacement_event_key_hash NOT GLOB '*[^0-9a-f]*'
    )
  ),
  retention_until INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (
    retention_until >= recorded_at
    AND retention_until <= recorded_at + 15552000
  ),
  created_at INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (created_at = recorded_at),
  FOREIGN KEY (event_name, event_version)
    REFERENCES analytics_event_registry(event_name, event_version)
    ON UPDATE RESTRICT ON DELETE RESTRICT,
  CHECK (
    (event_name != 'analytics_event_corrected'
      AND correction_kind = 'none'
      AND correction_of_event_key_hash IS NULL
      AND replacement_event_key_hash IS NULL)
    OR
    (event_name = 'analytics_event_corrected'
      AND correction_kind = 'retract'
      AND correction_of_event_key_hash IS NOT NULL
      AND replacement_event_key_hash IS NULL)
    OR
    (event_name = 'analytics_event_corrected'
      AND correction_kind = 'replace'
      AND correction_of_event_key_hash IS NOT NULL
      AND replacement_event_key_hash IS NOT NULL
      AND replacement_event_key_hash != correction_of_event_key_hash)
  )
)

objects.name: content_fact_sources

CREATE TABLE content_fact_sources (
  fact_source_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY CHECK (length(fact_source_id) = 36),
  source_key TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE
    CHECK (length(source_key) BETWEEN 16 AND 160),
  visibility TEXT NOT NULL
    CHECK (visibility IN ('public', 'private')),
  owner_telegram_id INTEGER REFERENCES users(telegram_id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  subject_type TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (subject_type IN (
    'partner_program', 'offer', 'official_snapshot', 'partner_offer'
  )),
  subject_key TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(subject_key) BETWEEN 1 AND 160),
  source_kind TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (source_kind IN (
    'server_record', 'official_snapshot', 'admin_verified'
  )),
  source_version TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(source_version) BETWEEN 1 AND 80),
  snapshot_hash TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(snapshot_hash) = 64),
  facts_json TEXT NOT NULL
    CHECK (json_valid(facts_json) AND json_type(facts_json) = 'object'),
  source_status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending'
    CHECK (source_status IN ('pending', 'approved', 'stale', 'revoked')),
  approved_by INTEGER,
  approved_at INTEGER,
  revoked_at INTEGER,
  created_at INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (created_at > 0),
  updated_at INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (updated_at >= created_at),
  UNIQUE (subject_type, subject_key, source_version, visibility, owner_telegram_id),
  CHECK (
    (visibility = 'public' AND owner_telegram_id IS NULL)
    OR (visibility = 'private' AND owner_telegram_id IS NOT NULL)
  ),
  CHECK (
    (source_status = 'pending'
      AND approved_by IS NULL AND approved_at IS NULL AND revoked_at IS NULL)
    OR
    (source_status IN ('approved', 'stale')
      AND approved_by IS NOT NULL AND approved_by > 0
      AND approved_at IS NOT NULL AND approved_at >= created_at
      AND revoked_at IS NULL)
    OR
    (source_status = 'revoked'
      AND approved_by IS NOT NULL AND approved_by > 0
      AND approved_at IS NOT NULL AND approved_at >= created_at
      AND revoked_at IS NOT NULL AND revoked_at >= approved_at)
  )
)

objects.name: payment_events
objects.sql:
CREATE TABLE payment_events (
  event_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY CHECK (length(event_id) BETWEEN 16 AND 96),
  event_key TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE CHECK (length(event_key) BETWEEN 16 AND 160),
  order_id TEXT REFERENCES subscription_orders(order_id),
  telegram_id INTEGER CHECK (telegram_id IS NULL OR telegram_id > 0),
  telegram_update_id INTEGER,
  event_type TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (event_type IN (
    'order_created', 'invoice_issued', 'precheckout_received',
    'precheckout_approved', 'precheckout_rejected',
    'successful_payment_received', 'payment_recorded',
    'access_applied', 'access_apply_failed',
    'refund_requested', 'refund_confirmed', 'refund_failed',
    'refunded_payment_received', 'chargeback_observed',
    'reconciliation_observed'
  )),
  outcome TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (outcome IN
    ('accepted', 'rejected', 'ignored', 'error')),
  reason_code TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '' CHECK (length(reason_code) <= 64),
  payload_sha256 TEXT CHECK (
    payload_sha256 IS NULL OR length(payload_sha256) = 64
  ),
  schema_version INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK (schema_version = 1),
  occurred_at INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (occurred_at > 0),
  received_at INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (received_at > 0)
)

objects.name: payment_ledger
objects.sql:
CREATE TABLE payment_ledger (
  ledger_entry_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY
    CHECK (length(ledger_entry_id) BETWEEN 16 AND 96),
  idempotency_key TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE
    CHECK (length(idempotency_key) BETWEEN 16 AND 160),
  order_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES subscription_orders(order_id),
  telegram_id INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (telegram_id > 0),
  entry_type TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (entry_type IN
    ('payment', 'refund', 'chargeback', 'adjustment')),
  direction TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (direction IN ('credit', 'debit')),
  currency TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (currency = 'XTR'),
  amount_stars INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (amount_stars BETWEEN 1 AND 10000),
  telegram_payment_charge_id TEXT CHECK (
    telegram_payment_charge_id IS NULL OR
    length(telegram_payment_charge_id) BETWEEN 1 AND 256
  ),
  provider_payment_charge_id TEXT CHECK (
    provider_payment_charge_id IS NULL OR
    length(provider_payment_charge_id) <= 256
  ),
  telegram_update_id INTEGER,
  related_ledger_entry_id TEXT REFERENCES payment_ledger(ledger_entry_id),
  reason_code TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '' CHECK (length(reason_code) <= 64),
  occurred_at INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (occurred_at > 0),
  recorded_at INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (recorded_at > 0),
  CHECK (
    (entry_type = 'payment' AND direction = 'credit'
      AND telegram_payment_charge_id IS NOT NULL
      AND related_ledger_entry_id IS NULL)
    OR
    (entry_type IN ('refund', 'chargeback') AND direction = 'debit'
      AND telegram_payment_charge_id IS NOT NULL
      AND related_ledger_entry_id IS NOT NULL)
    OR
    (entry_type = 'adjustment' AND related_ledger_entry_id IS NOT NULL)
  )
)

objects.name: payment_reconciliation_items
objects.sql:
CREATE TABLE payment_reconciliation_items (

  run_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES payment_reconciliation_runs(run_id),
  transaction_id_sha256 TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (
    length(transaction_id_sha256) = 64
  ),
  observation_side TEXT NOT NULL
    CHECK (observation_side IN ('telegram', 'local')),
  transaction_direction TEXT NOT NULL
    CHECK (transaction_direction IN ('incoming', 'outgoing')),
  partner_type TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '' CHECK (length(partner_type) <= 32),
  transaction_type TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT ''
    CHECK (length(transaction_type) <= 48),
  telegram_id INTEGER CHECK (telegram_id IS NULL OR telegram_id > 0),
  amount_stars INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (amount_stars > 0),
  transaction_date INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (transaction_date > 0),
  local_state TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (local_state IN (
    'matched', 'recovered', 'missing_local', 'missing_telegram',
    'mismatch', 'unsupported', 'manual_review'
  )),
  order_id TEXT REFERENCES subscription_orders(order_id),
  ledger_entry_id TEXT REFERENCES payment_ledger(ledger_entry_id),
  reason_code TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '' CHECK (length(reason_code) <= 64),
  observed_at INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (observed_at > 0)
)

objects.name: payment_reconciliation_runs
objects.sql:
CREATE TABLE payment_reconciliation_runs (
  run_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY CHECK (length(run_id) BETWEEN 16 AND 96),
  run_source TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (run_source IN ('scheduled', 'admin', 'release')),
  initiated_by INTEGER CHECK (initiated_by IS NULL OR initiated_by > 0),
  status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'running'
    CHECK (status IN ('running', 'completed', 'failed', 'manual_review')),
  offset_start INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (offset_start >= 0),
  offset_end INTEGER CHECK (offset_end IS NULL OR offset_end >= offset_start),
  transactions_seen INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (transactions_seen >= 0),
  transactions_matched INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (transactions_matched >= 0),
  missing_local INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (missing_local >= 0),
  missing_telegram INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (missing_telegram >= 0),
  discrepancies INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (discrepancies >= 0),
  error_code TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '' CHECK (length(error_code) <= 64),
  started_at INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (started_at > 0),
  finished_at INTEGER,
  updated_at INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (updated_at >= started_at),
  CHECK (
    (status = 'running' AND finished_at IS NULL)
    OR (status != 'running' AND finished_at IS NOT NULL
      AND finished_at >= started_at)
  )
)

objects.name: payment_refunds
objects.sql:
CREATE TABLE payment_refunds (
  refund_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY CHECK (length(refund_id) BETWEEN 16 AND 96),
  idempotency_key TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE
    CHECK (length(idempotency_key) BETWEEN 16 AND 160),
  order_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES subscription_orders(order_id),
  original_ledger_entry_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES payment_ledger(ledger_entry_id),
  telegram_id INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (telegram_id > 0),
  telegram_payment_charge_id TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE
    CHECK (length(telegram_payment_charge_id) BETWEEN 1 AND 256),
  currency TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (currency = 'XTR'),
  amount_stars INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (amount_stars BETWEEN 1 AND 10000),
  reason_code TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(reason_code) BETWEEN 3 AND 64),
  requested_by_type TEXT NOT NULL
    CHECK (requested_by_type IN ('telegram', 'admin', 'system')),
  requested_by INTEGER,
  status TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (status IN
    ('requested', 'confirmed', 'applied', 'failed', 'manual_review')),
  error_code TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '' CHECK (length(error_code) <= 64),
  requested_at INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (requested_at > 0),
  confirmed_at INTEGER,
  applied_at INTEGER,
  revision INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK (revision > 0),
  updated_at INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (updated_at >= requested_at),
  CHECK (
    (requested_by_type = 'admin' AND requested_by IS NOT NULL
      AND requested_by > 0)
    OR (requested_by_type != 'admin' AND requested_by IS NULL)
  ),
  CHECK (status NOT IN ('confirmed', 'applied') OR confirmed_at IS NOT NULL),
  CHECK (status != 'applied' OR applied_at IS NOT NULL)
)

objects.name: plan_aliases
objects.sql:
CREATE TABLE plan_aliases (
  alias_code TEXT NOT NULL COLLATE NOCASE,
  alias_version INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK (alias_version > 0),
  alias_kind TEXT NOT NULL
    CHECK (alias_kind IN ('canonical', 'legacy_state', 'legacy_plan')),
  target_plan_code TEXT REFERENCES plan_catalog(plan_code),
  target_access_state TEXT
    CHECK (target_access_state IS NULL OR target_access_state IN
      ('none', 'trial', 'active', 'cancel_at_period_end', 'expired',
       'refunded', 'suspended')),
  resolution_mode TEXT NOT NULL
    CHECK (resolution_mode IN
      ('canonical', 'preserve_legacy', 'manual_review', 'mapped_legacy')),
  accepts_new_writes INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0
    CHECK (accepts_new_writes IN (0, 1)),
  note TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
  created_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  PRIMARY KEY (alias_code, alias_version),
  CHECK (
    (alias_kind = 'canonical' AND target_plan_code IS NOT NULL
      AND target_access_state IS NULL AND resolution_mode = 'canonical'
      AND accepts_new_writes = 1)
    OR
    (alias_kind = 'legacy_state'
      AND target_access_state IS NOT NULL
      AND accepts_new_writes = 0
      AND (
        (resolution_mode = 'preserve_legacy' AND target_plan_code IS NULL)
        OR
        (resolution_mode = 'mapped_legacy' AND target_plan_code IS NOT NULL)
      ))
    OR
    (alias_kind = 'legacy_plan'
      AND accepts_new_writes = 0
      AND (
        (resolution_mode = 'manual_review' AND target_plan_code IS NULL
          AND target_access_state IS NULL)
        OR
        (resolution_mode = 'mapped_legacy' AND target_plan_code IS NOT NULL)
      ))
  )
)

objects.name: plan_switch_readiness_runs
objects.sql:
CREATE TABLE plan_switch_readiness_runs (
  run_key TEXT PRIMARY KEY
    CHECK (length(run_key) BETWEEN 8 AND 128),
  schema_version INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1
    CHECK (schema_version = 1),
  triggered_by INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (triggered_by > 0),
  note TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '' CHECK (length(note) <= 500),
  total_users INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (total_users >= 0),
  role_user_users INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (role_user_users >= 0),
  role_partner_users INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (role_partner_users >= 0),
  role_admin_users INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (role_admin_users >= 0),
  canonical_complete_users INTEGER NOT NULL
    CHECK (canonical_complete_users >= 0),
  review_required_users INTEGER NOT NULL
    CHECK (review_required_users >= 0),
  blocking_users INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (blocking_users >= 0),
  alias_canonical_users INTEGER NOT NULL
    CHECK (alias_canonical_users >= 0),
  alias_legacy_state_users INTEGER NOT NULL
    CHECK (alias_legacy_state_users >= 0),
  alias_legacy_plan_users INTEGER NOT NULL
    CHECK (alias_legacy_plan_users >= 0),
  alias_unknown_users INTEGER NOT NULL
    CHECK (alias_unknown_users >= 0),
  matched_users INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (matched_users >= 0),
  different_users INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (different_users >= 0),
  mapped_legacy_users INTEGER NOT NULL
    CHECK (mapped_legacy_users >= 0),
  missing_canonical_users INTEGER NOT NULL
    CHECK (missing_canonical_users >= 0),
  partial_canonical_users INTEGER NOT NULL
    CHECK (partial_canonical_users >= 0),
  manual_review_users INTEGER NOT NULL
    CHECK (manual_review_users >= 0),
  preserved_legacy_users INTEGER NOT NULL
    CHECK (preserved_legacy_users >= 0),
  mapped_legacy_mismatch_users INTEGER NOT NULL
    CHECK (mapped_legacy_mismatch_users >= 0),
  unknown_legacy_users INTEGER NOT NULL
    CHECK (unknown_legacy_users >= 0),
  ready_for_canonical_read INTEGER NOT NULL
    CHECK (ready_for_canonical_read IN (0, 1)),
  created_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  CHECK (
    role_user_users + role_partner_users + role_admin_users = total_users
  ),
  CHECK (
    alias_canonical_users + alias_legacy_state_users +
    alias_legacy_plan_users + alias_unknown_users = total_users
  ),
  CHECK (
    matched_users + different_users + mapped_legacy_users +
    missing_canonical_users + partial_canonical_users +
    manual_review_users + preserved_legacy_users +
    mapped_legacy_mismatch_users + unknown_legacy_users = total_users
  ),
  CHECK (canonical_complete_users <= total_users),
  CHECK (review_required_users <= total_users),
  CHECK (blocking_users <= total_users),
  CHECK (
    ready_for_canonical_read =
      CASE WHEN blocking_users = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
  )
)

objects.name: price_book
objects.sql:
CREATE TABLE price_book (
  price_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY
    CHECK (length(price_id) BETWEEN 12 AND 96),
  price_version INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (price_version > 0),
  plan_code TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES plan_catalog(plan_code)
    CHECK (plan_code IN ('professional', 'dragon')),
  currency TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (currency = 'XTR'),
  amount_stars INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (amount_stars BETWEEN 1 AND 10000),
  -- The v1.3.6 resolver releases only 30 days. The wider additive database
  -- envelope avoids a destructive table rebuild when prepaid 3/6/12-month
  -- packages are introduced by the later roadmap release.
  access_seconds INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (
    access_seconds BETWEEN 86400 AND 31622400
    AND access_seconds % 86400 = 0
  ),
  billing_mode TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (billing_mode IN ('prepaid', 'recurring')),
  publication_state TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'approved'
    CHECK (publication_state IN ('draft', 'approved', 'retired')),
  terms_revision TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(terms_revision) BETWEEN 8 AND 64),
  valid_from INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (valid_from > 0),
  valid_until INTEGER,
  created_at INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (created_at > 0),
  created_by TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'release'
    CHECK (length(created_by) BETWEEN 3 AND 64),
  UNIQUE (plan_code, billing_mode, access_seconds, price_version),
  CHECK (valid_until IS NULL OR valid_until > valid_from)
)

  program_code TEXT NOT NULL
    CHECK (program_code = 'first_paid_friend_v1'),
  buyer_telegram_id INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (buyer_telegram_id > 0),
  inviter_telegram_id INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (inviter_telegram_id > 0),
  source_order_id TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE
    REFERENCES subscription_orders(order_id),
  source_payment_ledger_entry_id TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE
    REFERENCES payment_ledger(ledger_entry_id),

    REFERENCES subscription_access_grants(grant_id),

    CHECK (buyer_plan_code IN ('professional', 'dragon')),
  amount_stars INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (amount_stars BETWEEN 1 AND 10000),
  first_started_at INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (first_started_at > 0),
  inviter_bound_at INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (inviter_bound_at > 0),
  paid_at INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (paid_at > 0),

    CHECK (eligible_until = first_started_at + 2592000),
  confirm_after INTEGER NOT NULL
    CHECK (confirm_after = paid_at + 1814400),

    CHECK (selection_reason = 'first_eligible_paid_friend'),
