  CHECK (buyer_telegram_id != inviter_telegram_id),
  CHECK (inviter_bound_at <= paid_at),
  CHECK (paid_at >= first_started_at),
  CHECK (paid_at <= eligible_until)
)

objects.name: referral_reward_notice_jobs
objects.sql:
CREATE TABLE referral_reward_notice_jobs (
  notice_key TEXT PRIMARY KEY
    CHECK (length(notice_key) BETWEEN 24 AND 180),
  source_event_key TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE
    CHECK (length(source_event_key) BETWEEN 20 AND 180),
  source_transition_id TEXT UNIQUE
    REFERENCES referral_reward_transitions(transition_id),
  source_expiry_event_id TEXT UNIQUE
    REFERENCES bonus_access_expiry_events(expiry_event_id),
  reward_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES referral_rewards(reward_id),
  bonus_grant_id TEXT REFERENCES bonus_access_grants(bonus_grant_id),
  recipient_telegram_id INTEGER NOT NULL
    CHECK (recipient_telegram_id > 0),
  notice_type TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (notice_type IN (
    'pending_review', 'reward_confirmed', 'bonus_claimable',
    'bonus_applied', 'reward_cancelled', 'claim_window_expired',
    'bonus_access_ended', 'bonus_manual_review'
  )),
  delivery_state TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending' CHECK (delivery_state IN (
    'pending', 'processing', 'retry', 'delivered', 'suppressed',
    'manual_review'
  )),
  not_before INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (not_before > 0),
  next_attempt_at INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (next_attempt_at >= not_before),
  attempt_count INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0
    CHECK (attempt_count BETWEEN 0 AND 10),
  lease_token TEXT,
  lease_expires_at INTEGER,
  last_attempt_at INTEGER,
  inbox_recorded_at INTEGER,
  delivered_at INTEGER,
  last_error_code TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT ''
    CHECK (length(last_error_code) <= 64),
  created_at INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (created_at > 0),
  updated_at INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (updated_at >= created_at),
  UNIQUE (reward_id, notice_type),
  CHECK (
    (notice_type IN ('pending_review', 'reward_confirmed', 'reward_cancelled')
      AND bonus_grant_id IS NULL)
    OR
    (notice_type IN (
      'bonus_claimable', 'bonus_applied', 'claim_window_expired',
      'bonus_access_ended', 'bonus_manual_review'
    ) AND bonus_grant_id IS NOT NULL)
  ),
  CHECK (
    (source_transition_id IS NOT NULL AND source_expiry_event_id IS NULL)
    OR
    (source_transition_id IS NULL AND source_expiry_event_id IS NOT NULL
      AND notice_type = 'bonus_access_ended')
  ),
  CHECK (
    (delivery_state = 'pending'
      AND attempt_count = 0
      AND lease_token IS NULL AND lease_expires_at IS NULL
      AND last_attempt_at IS NULL AND delivered_at IS NULL
      AND last_error_code = '')
    OR
    (delivery_state = 'processing'
      AND attempt_count BETWEEN 1 AND 10
      AND lease_token IS NOT NULL AND length(lease_token) = 36
      AND lease_expires_at IS NOT NULL
      AND last_attempt_at IS NOT NULL AND delivered_at IS NULL)
    OR
    (delivery_state = 'retry'
      AND attempt_count BETWEEN 1 AND 9
      AND lease_token IS NULL AND lease_expires_at IS NULL
      AND last_attempt_at IS NOT NULL AND delivered_at IS NULL
      AND last_error_code != '')
    OR
    (delivery_state IN ('delivered', 'suppressed')
      AND attempt_count BETWEEN 1 AND 10
      AND lease_token IS NULL AND lease_expires_at IS NULL
      AND last_attempt_at IS NOT NULL AND delivered_at IS NOT NULL)
    OR
    (delivery_state = 'manual_review'
      AND attempt_count BETWEEN 1 AND 10
      AND lease_token IS NULL AND lease_expires_at IS NULL
      AND last_attempt_at IS NOT NULL AND delivered_at IS NULL
      AND last_error_code != '')
  )
)

objects.name: referral_reward_protection_checks
objects.sql:
CREATE TABLE referral_reward_protection_checks (
  protection_check_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY
    CHECK (length(protection_check_id) = 36),
  check_key TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE CHECK (length(check_key) BETWEEN 16 AND 160),
  reward_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES referral_rewards(reward_id),
  candidate_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES referral_reward_candidates(candidate_id),
  reward_revision INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (reward_revision > 0),
  decision TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (decision IN ('confirm', 'cancel')),
  reason_code TEXT NOT NULL
    CHECK (reason_code IN ('hold_elapsed', 'refund', 'chargeback')),
  source_payment_ledger_entry_id TEXT NOT NULL
    REFERENCES payment_ledger(ledger_entry_id),
  source_access_grant_id TEXT NOT NULL
    REFERENCES subscription_access_grants(grant_id),
  reconciliation_run_id TEXT REFERENCES payment_reconciliation_runs(run_id),
  reconciliation_item_id TEXT REFERENCES payment_reconciliation_items(item_id),
  compensation_ledger_entry_id TEXT REFERENCES payment_ledger(ledger_entry_id),
  transition_id TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE
    CHECK (length(transition_id) BETWEEN 16 AND 96),
  checked_at INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (checked_at > 0),
  recorded_at INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (recorded_at >= checked_at),
  UNIQUE (reward_id, reward_revision),
  CHECK (
    (reconciliation_run_id IS NULL AND reconciliation_item_id IS NULL)
    OR
    (reconciliation_run_id IS NOT NULL AND reconciliation_item_id IS NOT NULL)
  ),
  CHECK (
    (decision = 'confirm'
      AND reason_code = 'hold_elapsed'
      AND reconciliation_run_id IS NOT NULL
      AND reconciliation_item_id IS NOT NULL
      AND compensation_ledger_entry_id IS NULL)
    OR
    (decision = 'cancel'
      AND reason_code IN ('refund', 'chargeback')
      AND compensation_ledger_entry_id IS NOT NULL)
  )
)

objects.name: referral_reward_protection_jobs
objects.sql:
CREATE TABLE referral_reward_protection_jobs (
  protection_job_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY CHECK (length(protection_job_id) = 36),
  job_key TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE CHECK (length(job_key) BETWEEN 16 AND 160),
  reward_id TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE REFERENCES referral_rewards(reward_id),
  candidate_id TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE
    REFERENCES referral_reward_candidates(candidate_id),
  workflow_instance_id TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE
    CHECK (length(workflow_instance_id) BETWEEN 20 AND 96),
  workflow_state TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending' CHECK (workflow_state IN (
    'pending', 'started', 'start_failed', 'completed', 'manual_review'
  )),
  scheduled_for INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (scheduled_for > 0),
  start_attempt_count INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0
    CHECK (start_attempt_count BETWEEN 0 AND 20),
  last_attempt_at INTEGER,
  started_at INTEGER,
  completed_at INTEGER,
  settlement_outcome TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT ''
    CHECK (settlement_outcome IN ('', 'confirmed', 'cancelled')),
  settled_transition_id TEXT UNIQUE
    REFERENCES referral_reward_transitions(transition_id),
  last_reconciliation_run_id TEXT
    REFERENCES payment_reconciliation_runs(run_id),
  last_error_code TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '' CHECK (length(last_error_code) <= 64),
  created_at INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (created_at > 0),
  updated_at INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (updated_at >= created_at),
  CHECK (
    (workflow_state = 'pending'
      AND start_attempt_count = 0
      AND last_attempt_at IS NULL
      AND started_at IS NULL
      AND completed_at IS NULL
      AND settlement_outcome = ''
      AND settled_transition_id IS NULL
      AND last_error_code = '')
    OR
    (workflow_state = 'started'
      AND start_attempt_count > 0
      AND last_attempt_at IS NOT NULL
      AND started_at IS NOT NULL
      AND completed_at IS NULL
      AND settlement_outcome = ''
      AND settled_transition_id IS NULL
      AND last_error_code = '')
    OR
    (workflow_state = 'start_failed'
      AND start_attempt_count > 0
      AND last_attempt_at IS NOT NULL
      AND completed_at IS NULL
      AND settlement_outcome = ''
      AND settled_transition_id IS NULL
      AND last_error_code != '')
    OR
    (workflow_state = 'manual_review'
      AND start_attempt_count > 0
      AND last_attempt_at IS NOT NULL
      AND completed_at IS NOT NULL
      AND settlement_outcome = ''
      AND settled_transition_id IS NULL
      AND last_error_code != '')
    OR
    (workflow_state = 'completed'
      AND start_attempt_count > 0
      AND last_attempt_at IS NOT NULL
      AND started_at IS NOT NULL
      AND completed_at IS NOT NULL
      AND completed_at >= started_at
      AND settlement_outcome IN ('confirmed', 'cancelled')
      AND settled_transition_id IS NOT NULL
      AND last_error_code = '')
  )
)

objects.name: referral_reward_transitions
objects.sql:
CREATE TABLE referral_reward_transitions (
  transition_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY
    CHECK (length(transition_id) BETWEEN 16 AND 96),
  transition_key TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE
    CHECK (length(transition_key) BETWEEN 16 AND 160),
  transition_scope TEXT NOT NULL
    CHECK (transition_scope IN ('reward', 'bonus_grant')),
  reward_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES referral_rewards(reward_id),
  bonus_grant_id TEXT REFERENCES bonus_access_grants(bonus_grant_id),
  from_status TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (from_status IN (
    'none', 'pending', 'confirmed', 'claimable', 'applied'
  )),
  to_status TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (to_status IN (
    'pending', 'confirmed', 'cancelled', 'claimable', 'applied',
    'expired', 'revoked', 'manual_review'
  )),
  from_revision INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (from_revision >= 0),
  to_revision INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (to_revision = from_revision + 1),
  reason_code TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(reason_code) BETWEEN 3 AND 64),
  actor_type TEXT NOT NULL
    CHECK (actor_type IN ('workflow', 'system', 'telegram', 'admin')),
  actor_id INTEGER,
  related_payment_ledger_entry_id TEXT NOT NULL
    REFERENCES payment_ledger(ledger_entry_id),
  effect_starts_at INTEGER,
  effect_ends_at INTEGER,
  compensated_seconds INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0
    CHECK (compensated_seconds BETWEEN 0 AND 259200),
  occurred_at INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (occurred_at > 0),
  recorded_at INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (recorded_at >= occurred_at),
  CHECK (
    (transition_scope = 'reward' AND bonus_grant_id IS NULL AND (
      (from_status = 'none' AND to_status = 'pending')
      OR (from_status = 'pending' AND to_status IN ('confirmed', 'cancelled'))
      OR (from_status = 'confirmed' AND to_status = 'cancelled')
    ))
    OR
    (transition_scope = 'bonus_grant' AND bonus_grant_id IS NOT NULL AND (
      (from_status = 'none' AND to_status IN ('pending', 'claimable'))
      OR (from_status = 'pending' AND to_status IN ('applied', 'revoked'))
      OR (from_status = 'claimable'
        AND to_status IN ('applied', 'expired', 'revoked'))
      OR (from_status = 'applied'
        AND to_status IN ('revoked', 'manual_review'))
    ))
  ),
  CHECK (
    (from_status = 'none' AND from_revision = 0 AND to_revision = 1)
    OR (from_status != 'none' AND from_revision > 0)
  ),
  CHECK (
    (actor_type IN ('admin', 'telegram')
      AND actor_id IS NOT NULL AND actor_id > 0)
    OR (actor_type IN ('workflow', 'system') AND actor_id IS NULL)
  ),
  CHECK (
    (transition_scope = 'bonus_grant' AND to_status = 'applied'
      AND effect_starts_at IS NOT NULL
      AND effect_ends_at IS NOT NULL
      AND effect_ends_at = effect_starts_at + 259200)
    OR
    (NOT (transition_scope = 'bonus_grant' AND to_status = 'applied')
      AND effect_starts_at IS NULL AND effect_ends_at IS NULL)
  ),
  CHECK (transition_scope = 'bonus_grant' OR compensated_seconds = 0),
  CHECK (
    reason_code IN ('refund', 'chargeback') OR compensated_seconds = 0
  )
)

objects.name: referral_rewards
objects.sql:
CREATE TABLE referral_rewards (
  reward_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY CHECK (length(reward_id) = 36),
  reward_key TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE CHECK (length(reward_key) BETWEEN 16 AND 160),
  candidate_id TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE
    REFERENCES referral_reward_candidates(candidate_id),
  program_code TEXT NOT NULL
    CHECK (program_code = 'first_paid_friend_v1'),
  beneficiary_telegram_id INTEGER NOT NULL
    CHECK (beneficiary_telegram_id > 0),
  buyer_telegram_id INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (buyer_telegram_id > 0),
  reward_seconds INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (reward_seconds = 259200),
  reward_status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending'
    CHECK (reward_status IN ('pending', 'confirmed', 'cancelled')),
  confirm_after INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (confirm_after > 0),
  confirmed_at INTEGER,
  cancelled_at INTEGER,
  last_transition_id TEXT,
  revision INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK (revision > 0),
  created_at INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (created_at > 0),
  updated_at INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (updated_at >= created_at),
  UNIQUE (program_code, beneficiary_telegram_id),
  UNIQUE (program_code, buyer_telegram_id),
  CHECK (beneficiary_telegram_id != buyer_telegram_id),
  CHECK (
    (reward_status = 'pending'
      AND confirmed_at IS NULL AND cancelled_at IS NULL)
    OR
    (reward_status = 'confirmed'
      AND confirmed_at IS NOT NULL AND confirmed_at >= confirm_after
      AND cancelled_at IS NULL)
    OR
    (reward_status = 'cancelled'
      AND cancelled_at IS NOT NULL
      AND cancelled_at >= created_at
      AND (confirmed_at IS NULL OR cancelled_at >= confirmed_at))
  )
)

objects.name: subscription_access_grants
objects.sql:
CREATE TABLE subscription_access_grants (
  grant_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY CHECK (length(grant_id) = 36),
  grant_key TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE
    CHECK (length(grant_key) BETWEEN 16 AND 160),
  subscription_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES subscriptions(subscription_id),
  order_id TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE REFERENCES subscription_orders(order_id),
  payment_ledger_entry_id TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE
    REFERENCES payment_ledger(ledger_entry_id),
  telegram_id INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (telegram_id > 0),
  plan_code TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (plan_code IN ('professional', 'dragon')),
  access_seconds INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (
    access_seconds BETWEEN 86400 AND 31622400
    AND access_seconds % 86400 = 0
  ),
  starts_at INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (starts_at > 0),
  ends_at INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (ends_at = starts_at + access_seconds),
  status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'active'
    CHECK (status IN ('active', 'refunded', 'chargeback')),
  compensation_ledger_entry_id TEXT UNIQUE
    REFERENCES payment_ledger(ledger_entry_id),
  created_at INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (created_at > 0),
  updated_at INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (updated_at >= created_at),
  CHECK (
    (status = 'active' AND compensation_ledger_entry_id IS NULL)
    OR
    (status IN ('refunded', 'chargeback')
      AND compensation_ledger_entry_id IS NOT NULL)
  )
)

objects.name: subscription_orders
objects.sql:
CREATE TABLE subscription_orders (
  order_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY CHECK (length(order_id) = 36),
  telegram_id INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (telegram_id > 0),
  price_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES price_book(price_id),
  price_version INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (price_version > 0),
  plan_code TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (plan_code IN ('professional', 'dragon')),
  currency TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (currency = 'XTR'),
  amount_stars INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (amount_stars BETWEEN 1 AND 10000),
  access_seconds INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (
    access_seconds BETWEEN 86400 AND 31622400
    AND access_seconds % 86400 = 0
  ),
  billing_mode TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (billing_mode IN ('prepaid', 'recurring')),
  terms_revision TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(terms_revision) BETWEEN 8 AND 64),
  invoice_payload TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE
    CHECK (length(invoice_payload) BETWEEN 1 AND 128),
  order_state TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'created' CHECK (order_state IN (
    'created', 'precheckout_ok', 'paid', 'applied',
    'refunded', 'chargeback', 'failed', 'cancelled'
  )),
  state_revision INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK (state_revision > 0),
  created_at INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (created_at > 0),
  expires_at INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (expires_at > created_at),
  precheckout_approved_at INTEGER,
  paid_at INTEGER,
  applied_at INTEGER,
  closed_at INTEGER,
  updated_at INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (updated_at >= created_at),
  CHECK (precheckout_approved_at IS NULL OR precheckout_approved_at >= created_at),
  CHECK (paid_at IS NULL OR paid_at >= created_at),
  CHECK (applied_at IS NULL OR applied_at >= created_at),
  CHECK (closed_at IS NULL OR closed_at >= created_at),
  CHECK (order_state != 'precheckout_ok' OR precheckout_approved_at IS NOT NULL),
  CHECK (order_state NOT IN ('paid', 'applied') OR paid_at IS NOT NULL),
  CHECK (order_state != 'applied' OR applied_at IS NOT NULL)
)

  SET current_version_no = NEW.version_no,

        WHEN updated_at < NEW.created_at THEN NEW.created_at
        ELSE updated_at
      END

END

objects.name: trg_ai_draft_versions_owner_fact_guard

CREATE TRIGGER trg_ai_draft_versions_owner_fact_guard
BEFORE INSERT ON ai_draft_versions
WHEN EXISTS (
  SELECT 1
  FROM json_each(NEW.fact_source_ids_json) requested
  JOIN ai_drafts draft ON draft.draft_id = NEW.draft_id
  LEFT JOIN content_fact_sources source
    ON source.fact_source_id = requested.value
  WHERE source.fact_source_id IS NULL
    OR source.source_status != 'approved'
    OR (
      source.visibility = 'private'
      AND source.owner_telegram_id != draft.owner_telegram_id
    )
)
BEGIN
  SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'AI draft fact source is missing, stale or outside owner scope');
END

END

objects.name: trg_ai_partner_draft_versions_confirmed_guard
objects.sql:
CREATE TRIGGER trg_ai_partner_draft_versions_confirmed_guard
BEFORE INSERT ON ai_draft_versions
WHEN NEW.request_id LIKE 'a138wr:%' AND NOT EXISTS (
  SELECT 1 FROM ai_partner_write_intents intent
  JOIN ai_partner_write_payloads payload ON payload.intent_id = intent.intent_id
  JOIN ai_drafts draft ON draft.draft_id = NEW.draft_id
  WHERE NEW.request_id = 'a138wr:' || intent.intent_id
    AND intent.intent_state = 'consumed'
    AND intent.owner_telegram_id = payload.owner_telegram_id
    AND intent.owner_telegram_id = draft.owner_telegram_id
    AND draft.draft_state = 'draft'
    AND payload.planned_draft_id = NEW.draft_id
    AND payload.draft_type = draft.draft_type
    AND NEW.version_no = payload.expected_current_version_no + 1
    AND NEW.content_hash = payload.preview_hash
    AND NEW.model_alias = 'qwen_safe'
    AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM ai_partner_write_events event
      WHERE event.intent_id = intent.intent_id
        AND event.owner_telegram_id = intent.owner_telegram_id
        AND event.event_type = 'confirmed'
        AND event.occurred_at = intent.resolved_at
    )
)
BEGIN
  SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'AI draft write lacks exact owner confirmation');
END

objects.name: trg_ai_partner_draft_versions_human_confirmed_guard
objects.sql:
CREATE TRIGGER trg_ai_partner_draft_versions_human_confirmed_guard
BEFORE INSERT ON ai_draft_versions
WHEN NEW.request_id LIKE 'a138we:%' AND NOT EXISTS (
  SELECT 1 FROM ai_partner_write_intents intent
  JOIN ai_partner_write_payloads payload ON payload.intent_id = intent.intent_id
  JOIN ai_drafts draft ON draft.draft_id = NEW.draft_id
  WHERE NEW.request_id = 'a138we:' || intent.intent_id
    AND intent.intent_state = 'consumed'
    AND intent.action_type = 'save_own_draft_version'
    AND intent.owner_telegram_id = payload.owner_telegram_id
    AND intent.owner_telegram_id = draft.owner_telegram_id
    AND draft.draft_state = 'draft'
    AND payload.planned_draft_id = NEW.draft_id
    AND payload.draft_type = draft.draft_type
    AND NEW.version_no = payload.expected_current_version_no + 1
    AND NEW.content_hash = payload.preview_hash
    AND NEW.version_origin = 'user'
    AND NEW.model_alias = 'human_edit'
    AND json_extract(payload.template_json, '$.versionOrigin') = 'user'
    AND json_extract(payload.template_json, '$.modelAlias') = 'human_edit'
    AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM ai_partner_write_events event
      WHERE event.intent_id = intent.intent_id
        AND event.owner_telegram_id = intent.owner_telegram_id
        AND event.event_type = 'confirmed'
        AND event.occurred_at = intent.resolved_at
    )
)
BEGIN
  SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'AI draft write lacks exact owner confirmation');
END

  SELECT 1
  FROM ai_generation_provider_evidence evidence
  JOIN ai_draft_versions version
    ON version.version_id = NEW.version_id
  JOIN ai_drafts draft
    ON draft.draft_id = version.draft_id
  WHERE evidence.generation_id = NEW.generation_id
    AND evidence.owner_telegram_id = NEW.owner_telegram_id
    AND evidence.recorded_at <= NEW.completed_at
    AND version.request_id = NEW.version_request_id
    AND version.generation_state = 'complete'
    AND version.content_hash = NEW.stream_digest
    AND version.model_alias = evidence.final_model_alias
    AND version.fact_source_ids_json = NEW.fact_source_ids_json
    AND json_extract(version.structured_payload_json, '$.factBundleHash')
      = NEW.fact_bundle_hash
    AND version.version_no = NEW.base_version_no + 1
    AND draft.draft_id = NEW.draft_id
    AND draft.owner_telegram_id = NEW.owner_telegram_id
    AND draft.draft_type = NEW.draft_type
    AND draft.current_version_no = version.version_no
)

END

    AND (

       AND intent.intent_state = 'pending'
       AND intent.issued_at = NEW.occurred_at)
      OR

       AND intent.intent_state = 'consumed'

      OR

       AND intent.intent_state = 'expired'
       AND intent.resolved_at = NEW.occurred_at)
    )
    AND (NEW.event_type NOT IN ('prepared', 'confirmed') OR EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM ai_partner_write_payloads payload
      WHERE payload.intent_id = intent.intent_id
        AND payload.owner_telegram_id = intent.owner_telegram_id

CREATE TRIGGER trg_ambassador_campaigns_create_draft
BEFORE INSERT ON ambassador_campaigns
WHEN NEW.status != 'draft' OR NEW.revision != 1 OR NEW.activated_at IS NOT NULL
  OR NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM ambassador_profiles_v2 profile
    WHERE profile.ambassador_id = NEW.ambassador_id
      AND profile.status = 'active'
  )
  OR NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM partner_programs program
    WHERE program.code = NEW.program_code AND program.status = 'active'
  )
  OR (
    NEW.scope_kind = 'offer'
    AND NOT EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM program_offers offer
      WHERE offer.id = NEW.catalog_offer_id

objects.name: trg_ambassador_campaigns_transition

CREATE TRIGGER trg_ambassador_campaigns_transition
BEFORE UPDATE ON ambassador_campaigns
WHEN NEW.revision != OLD.revision + 1
  OR NEW.status = OLD.status
  OR NEW.updated_at < OLD.updated_at
  OR NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM ambassador_campaign_transitions transition
    WHERE transition.campaign_id = OLD.campaign_id
      AND transition.campaign_revision = NEW.revision
      AND transition.from_status = OLD.status
      AND transition.to_status = NEW.status
      AND transition.evidence_hash = NEW.scope_evidence_hash
      AND transition.occurred_at = NEW.updated_at
  )
  OR (
    OLD.status = 'draft'
    AND NOT (
      (NEW.status = 'active' AND NEW.activated_at = NEW.updated_at)
      OR (NEW.status = 'archived' AND NEW.activated_at IS NULL)
    )
  )
  OR (
    NEW.status = 'active'
    AND (
      NEW.updated_at < NEW.starts_at OR NEW.updated_at > NEW.ends_at
      OR NOT EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM ambassador_profiles_v2 profile
        WHERE profile.ambassador_id = NEW.ambassador_id
          AND profile.status = 'active'
      )
      OR NOT EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM partner_programs program
        WHERE program.code = NEW.program_code
          AND program.status = 'active'
      )
      OR (
        NEW.scope_kind = 'offer'
        AND NOT EXISTS (
          SELECT 1 FROM program_offers offer
          WHERE offer.id = NEW.catalog_offer_id
            AND offer.program_code = NEW.program_code
            AND offer.status = 'active'
        )
      )
    )
  )
BEGIN
  SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'ambassador campaign update requires exact transition');
END

      revision = NEW.profile_revision,

objects.name: trg_p05_fence_proof_insert
objects.sql:
CREATE TRIGGER trg_p05_fence_proof_insert
BEFORE INSERT ON analytics_privacy_fence_reconciliation
WHEN NOT EXISTS (
  SELECT 1 FROM analytics_privacy_projection_fence f
  WHERE f.id = 1 AND f.created_at = NEW.fence_created_at
) OR NEW.last_denial_at != COALESCE(
  (SELECT MAX(denied_at) FROM analytics_privacy_denials), 0
) OR NEW.validated_at > unixepoch()
  OR NEW.checkpoint_count != (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM analytics_projection_checkpoints)
  OR (NEW.checkpoint_count = 0 AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM canonical_analytics_events WHERE retention_until > unixepoch()
    ))
  OR EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM analytics_projection_checkpoints checkpoint
    LEFT JOIN analytics_projection_snapshots snapshot
      ON snapshot.snapshot_id = checkpoint.current_snapshot_id
    LEFT JOIN analytics_projection_reconciliation reconciliation
      ON reconciliation.snapshot_id = checkpoint.current_snapshot_id
    WHERE snapshot.created_at <= NEW.last_denial_at
      OR snapshot.snapshot_id IS NULL OR reconciliation.snapshot_id IS NULL
      OR reconciliation.source_delta != 0
      OR reconciliation.canonical_delta != 0
      OR reconciliation.projection_delta != 0
  )
  OR EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM canonical_analytics_events event
    JOIN analytics_privacy_denials denied
      ON denied.subject_pseudonym = event.actor_pseudonym
  )
BEGIN
  SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'privacy fence reconciliation is incomplete');
END

    AND proof.validated_at > proof.last_denial_at
    AND proof.validated_at <= unixepoch()
    AND NOT EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM analytics_projection_checkpoints checkpoint
      JOIN analytics_projection_snapshots snapshot
        ON snapshot.snapshot_id = checkpoint.current_snapshot_id

)

END

objects.name: trg_projection_binding_authority
objects.sql:
CREATE TRIGGER trg_projection_binding_authority
BEFORE INSERT ON analytics_projection_attribution_bindings
WHEN NOT EXISTS (
  SELECT 1
  FROM canonical_analytics_events event
  LEFT JOIN analytics_attribution_touchpoints touch
    ON touch.touchpoint_id = NEW.touchpoint_id
  LEFT JOIN analytics_attribution_decisions decision
    ON decision.decision_id = NEW.decision_id
  LEFT JOIN ambassador_campaigns campaign
    ON campaign.campaign_id = NEW.campaign_id
  WHERE event.event_id = NEW.event_id
    AND event.correction_kind = 'none'
    AND NEW.retention_until <= event.retention_until
    AND (
      (NEW.evidence_kind = 'touchpoint'
        AND event.event_name = 'campaign_touch_recorded'
        AND touch.actor_pseudonym = event.actor_pseudonym
        AND touch.occurred_at = event.occurred_at
        AND touch.ambassador_id = NEW.ambassador_id
        AND touch.campaign_id = NEW.campaign_id
        AND campaign.ambassador_id = NEW.ambassador_id
        AND campaign.program_code = NEW.program_code
        AND campaign.catalog_offer_id IS NEW.catalog_offer_id)
      OR
      (NEW.evidence_kind = 'decision'
        AND decision.actor_pseudonym = event.actor_pseudonym
        AND decision.occurred_at = event.occurred_at
        AND decision.outcome = 'attributed'
        AND decision.ambassador_id = NEW.ambassador_id
        AND decision.campaign_id IS NEW.campaign_id
        AND (
          (event.event_name = 'registration_attributed'
            AND decision.attribution_kind IN ('relationship', 'engagement'))
          OR (event.event_name = 'lead_attributed'
            AND decision.attribution_kind = 'commercial'
            AND decision.authority_kind = 'lead_partner_attribution')
          OR (event.event_name = 'paid_access_attributed'
            AND decision.attribution_kind = 'commercial'
            AND decision.authority_kind = 'stars_access')
          OR (event.event_name = 'referral_reward_confirmed'
            AND decision.attribution_kind = 'commercial'
            AND decision.authority_kind = 'referral_reward')
        )
        AND (
          (decision.campaign_id IS NULL
            AND NEW.campaign_id IS NULL
            AND EXISTS (
              SELECT 1 FROM ambassador_profiles_v2 profile
              JOIN partner_programs program ON program.code = NEW.program_code
              WHERE profile.ambassador_id = NEW.ambassador_id
                AND program.status = 'active'
            ))
          OR (decision.campaign_id IS NOT NULL
            AND campaign.ambassador_id = NEW.ambassador_id
            AND campaign.program_code = NEW.program_code
            AND campaign.catalog_offer_id IS NEW.catalog_offer_id)
        )
      )
    )
)
BEGIN
  SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'analytics projection attribution authority mismatch');
END

objects.name: trg_bonus_access_effects_guard
objects.sql:
CREATE TRIGGER trg_bonus_access_effects_guard
BEFORE INSERT ON bonus_access_effects
WHEN NOT EXISTS (
  SELECT 1
  FROM bonus_access_grants grant_record
  JOIN referral_rewards reward
    ON reward.reward_id = grant_record.reward_id
  JOIN referral_reward_candidates candidate
    ON candidate.candidate_id = reward.candidate_id
  JOIN referral_reward_transitions transition
    ON transition.transition_id = NEW.applied_transition_id
  JOIN user_plans plans
    ON plans.telegram_id = grant_record.beneficiary_telegram_id
  JOIN user_access_states access_state
    ON access_state.telegram_id = grant_record.beneficiary_telegram_id
  LEFT JOIN subscriptions subscription
    ON subscription.subscription_id = NEW.target_subscription_id
  WHERE grant_record.bonus_grant_id = NEW.bonus_grant_id
    AND grant_record.reward_id = NEW.reward_id
    AND grant_record.beneficiary_telegram_id = NEW.beneficiary_telegram_id
    AND grant_record.plan_code = NEW.plan_code
    AND grant_record.grant_status = 'applied'
    AND grant_record.last_transition_id = NEW.applied_transition_id
    AND grant_record.starts_at = NEW.effect_starts_at
    AND grant_record.ends_at = NEW.effect_ends_at
    AND reward.reward_status = 'confirmed'
    AND candidate.source_payment_ledger_entry_id =
      NEW.source_payment_ledger_entry_id
    AND transition.transition_scope = 'bonus_grant'
    AND transition.reward_id = NEW.reward_id
    AND transition.bonus_grant_id = NEW.bonus_grant_id
    AND transition.to_status = 'applied'
    AND transition.effect_starts_at = NEW.effect_starts_at
    AND transition.effect_ends_at = NEW.effect_ends_at
    AND plans.plan_code = NEW.plan_code
    AND plans.revision = NEW.result_plan_revision
    AND CAST(strftime('%s', plans.effective_until) AS INTEGER) =
      NEW.effect_ends_at
    AND access_state.revision = NEW.result_access_revision
    AND access_state.access_state = CASE
      WHEN NEW.effect_kind = 'manual_professional_access' THEN 'active'
      ELSE NEW.prior_access_state
    END
    AND CAST(strftime('%s', access_state.state_ends_at) AS INTEGER) =
      NEW.effect_ends_at
    AND NOT EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM payment_ledger compensation
      WHERE compensation.related_ledger_entry_id =
        candidate.source_payment_ledger_entry_id
        AND compensation.entry_type IN ('refund', 'chargeback')
    )
    AND (
      (NEW.effect_kind = 'manual_professional_access'
        AND grant_record.delivery_mode = 'manual_claim'
        AND transition.reason_code = 'manual_claim'
        AND transition.actor_type = 'telegram'
        AND NEW.target_subscription_id IS NULL
        AND plans.source_code = 'referral_bonus_manual'
        AND access_state.source_code = 'referral_bonus_manual'
        AND (
          NEW.prior_access_state != 'trial'
          OR EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM trial_grants preview
            WHERE preview.telegram_id = NEW.beneficiary_telegram_id
              AND preview.program_code = 'dragon_preview'
              AND preview.status = 'expired'
              AND preview.ended_at = NEW.effect_starts_at
          )
        ))
      OR
      (NEW.effect_kind = 'paid_plan_extension'
        AND grant_record.delivery_mode = 'extend_active_plan'
        AND transition.reason_code = 'active_plan_extension'
        AND transition.actor_type = 'workflow'
        AND subscription.subscription_id = NEW.target_subscription_id
        AND subscription.telegram_id = NEW.beneficiary_telegram_id
        AND subscription.plan_code = NEW.plan_code
        AND subscription.status IN ('active', 'cancel_at_period_end')
        AND subscription.current_period_end = NEW.effect_ends_at
        AND subscription.revision = NEW.result_subscription_revision
        AND plans.source_code = 'referral_bonus_extension'
        AND access_state.source_code = 'referral_bonus_extension')
    )
)
BEGIN
  SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'bonus access effect lacks matching entitlement state');
END

    AND effect.bonus_grant_id = NEW.bonus_grant_id
    AND effect.reward_id = NEW.reward_id
    AND effect.beneficiary_telegram_id = NEW.beneficiary_telegram_id
    AND effect.effect_starts_at = NEW.access_would_start_at
    AND effect.effect_ends_at = NEW.access_would_end_at
    AND reward.reward_status = 'cancelled'
    AND grant_record.grant_status = 'revoked'
    AND grant_record.compensation_ledger_entry_id =
      NEW.compensation_ledger_entry_id
    AND grant_record.compensated_seconds = NEW.removed_seconds
    AND compensation.related_ledger_entry_id =
      candidate.source_payment_ledger_entry_id
    AND compensation.entry_type IN ('refund', 'chargeback')
    AND compensation.entry_type = (
      SELECT reason_code
      FROM referral_reward_transitions
      WHERE transition_id = grant_record.last_transition_id
    )
    AND compensation.occurred_at = NEW.compensation_occurred_at
    AND compensation.recorded_at <= NEW.recorded_at
    AND plans.revision = NEW.result_plan_revision
    AND access_state.revision = NEW.result_access_revision
    AND (
      (NEW.reversal_kind = 'manual_access_removed'
        AND effect.effect_kind = 'manual_professional_access'
        AND NEW.target_subscription_id IS NULL
        AND plans.plan_code = 'free'
        AND plans.source_code = 'referral_bonus_compensation'
        AND access_state.access_state = 'expired'
        AND access_state.source_code = 'referral_bonus_compensation')
      OR
      (NEW.reversal_kind = 'paid_extension_removed'
        AND effect.effect_kind = 'paid_plan_extension'
        AND subscription.subscription_id = NEW.target_subscription_id
        AND subscription.current_period_end = NEW.access_would_start_at
        AND subscription.revision = NEW.result_subscription_revision
        AND plans.plan_code = effect.plan_code
        AND plans.source_code = 'referral_bonus_compensation'
        AND access_state.access_state = effect.prior_access_state
        AND access_state.source_code = 'referral_bonus_compensation'
        AND CAST(strftime('%s', plans.effective_until) AS INTEGER) =
          NEW.access_would_start_at
        AND CAST(strftime('%s', access_state.state_ends_at) AS INTEGER) =
          NEW.access_would_start_at)
    )
)
BEGIN
  SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'bonus reversal lacks matching compensation state');
END

objects.name: trg_cabinet_access_resolution_validate
objects.sql:
CREATE TRIGGER trg_cabinet_access_resolution_validate
BEFORE INSERT ON cabinet_access_resolution_receipts
WHEN NOT EXISTS (
  SELECT 1 FROM cabinet_access_resolution_receipts existing
  WHERE existing.idempotency_key = NEW.idempotency_key
)
BEGIN
  SELECT CASE WHEN NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM cabinet_access_e2e_settings settings,
      cabinet_v1_settings cabinet
    WHERE settings.id = 1 AND settings.rollout_mode = 'admin_shadow'
      AND settings.master_enabled = 1
      AND settings.access_projection_enabled = 1
      AND settings.resolution_version = NEW.resolution_version
      AND settings.resolution_ttl_seconds = 300
      AND cabinet.id = 1 AND cabinet.rollout_mode = 'admin_shadow'
      AND cabinet.master_enabled = 1 AND cabinet.profile_enabled = 1
  ) THEN RAISE(ABORT, 'access resolution gate is closed') END;

  SELECT CASE WHEN NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM users subject
    JOIN user_plans plan ON plan.telegram_id = subject.telegram_id
    JOIN user_access_states state ON state.telegram_id = subject.telegram_id
    JOIN cabinet_tariff_capacity capacity
      ON capacity.plan_code = NEW.plan_code
    JOIN cabinet_plan_quotas quota
      ON quota.plan_code = NEW.plan_code
      AND quota.quota_code = 'active_applications'
    WHERE subject.telegram_id = NEW.subject_telegram_id
      AND subject.is_blocked = 0
      AND plan.plan_code = NEW.base_plan_code
      AND plan.revision = NEW.user_plan_revision
      AND unixepoch(plan.effective_from) <= NEW.created_at
      AND (plan.effective_until IS NULL
        OR unixepoch(plan.effective_until) > NEW.created_at)
      AND state.access_state = NEW.access_state
      AND state.revision = NEW.access_state_revision
      AND (NEW.source_kind != 'dragon_preview' OR (
        unixepoch(state.state_started_at) = NEW.source_starts_at
        AND unixepoch(state.state_ends_at) = NEW.source_ends_at
      ))
      AND capacity.capacity_version = 1
      AND capacity.capacity_percent = NEW.capacity_percent
      AND quota.quota_version = 1
      AND quota.limit_value = NEW.active_application_limit
  ) THEN RAISE(ABORT, 'access projection authority mismatch') END;

  SELECT CASE WHEN NEW.source_kind = 'free_default' AND NOT (
    NOT EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM trial_grants preview
      WHERE preview.telegram_id = NEW.subject_telegram_id
        AND preview.program_code = 'dragon_preview'
        AND preview.status = 'active'
        AND preview.started_at <= NEW.created_at
        AND preview.ends_at > NEW.created_at
    )
    AND NOT EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM subscriptions subscription
      JOIN subscription_access_grants access
        ON access.subscription_id = subscription.subscription_id
      WHERE subscription.telegram_id = NEW.subject_telegram_id
        AND subscription.status IN ('active', 'cancel_at_period_end')
        AND subscription.current_period_start <= NEW.created_at
        AND subscription.current_period_end > NEW.created_at
        AND access.telegram_id = NEW.subject_telegram_id
        AND access.plan_code = subscription.plan_code
        AND access.status = 'active'
        AND access.ends_at = subscription.current_period_end
    )
  ) THEN RAISE(ABORT, 'free access authority mismatch') END;

  SELECT CASE WHEN NEW.source_kind = 'dragon_preview' AND NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM trial_grants preview
    WHERE preview.grant_id = NEW.trial_grant_id
      AND preview.telegram_id = NEW.subject_telegram_id
      AND preview.program_code = 'dragon_preview'
      AND preview.status = 'active'
      AND preview.started_at = NEW.source_starts_at
      AND preview.ends_at = NEW.source_ends_at
      AND preview.started_at <= NEW.created_at
      AND preview.ends_at > NEW.created_at
      AND NEW.valid_until <= preview.ends_at
      AND NOT EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM subscriptions subscription
        JOIN subscription_access_grants access
          ON access.subscription_id = subscription.subscription_id
        WHERE subscription.telegram_id = NEW.subject_telegram_id
          AND subscription.status IN ('active', 'cancel_at_period_end')
          AND subscription.current_period_start <= NEW.created_at
          AND subscription.current_period_end > NEW.created_at
          AND access.telegram_id = NEW.subject_telegram_id
          AND access.status = 'active'
          AND access.ends_at = subscription.current_period_end
      )
  ) THEN RAISE(ABORT, 'Dragon Preview authority mismatch') END;

  SELECT CASE WHEN NEW.source_kind = 'stars_subscription' AND NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM subscriptions subscription
    JOIN subscription_access_grants access
      ON access.grant_id = NEW.access_grant_id
      AND access.subscription_id = subscription.subscription_id
    JOIN user_plans plan ON plan.telegram_id = subscription.telegram_id
    JOIN user_access_states state ON state.telegram_id = subscription.telegram_id
    WHERE subscription.subscription_id = NEW.subscription_id
      AND subscription.telegram_id = NEW.subject_telegram_id
      AND subscription.plan_code = NEW.plan_code
      AND subscription.status = NEW.access_state
      AND subscription.status IN ('active', 'cancel_at_period_end')
      AND subscription.current_period_start = NEW.source_starts_at
      AND subscription.current_period_end = NEW.source_ends_at
      AND subscription.current_period_start <= NEW.created_at
      AND subscription.current_period_end > NEW.created_at
      AND access.telegram_id = NEW.subject_telegram_id
      AND access.plan_code = NEW.plan_code
      AND access.status = 'active'
      AND access.starts_at <= NEW.created_at
      AND access.ends_at = subscription.current_period_end
      AND plan.plan_code = subscription.plan_code
      AND plan.revision = NEW.user_plan_revision
      AND unixepoch(plan.effective_until) = subscription.current_period_end
      AND state.access_state = subscription.status
      AND state.revision = NEW.access_state_revision
      AND unixepoch(state.state_ends_at) = subscription.current_period_end
      AND NEW.valid_until <= subscription.current_period_end
      AND NOT EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM trial_grants preview
        WHERE preview.telegram_id = NEW.subject_telegram_id
          AND preview.program_code = 'dragon_preview'
          AND preview.status = 'active'
          AND preview.started_at <= NEW.created_at
          AND preview.ends_at > NEW.created_at
      )
  ) THEN RAISE(ABORT, 'Stars access authority mismatch') END;
END

      ON result.application_id = application.application_id
    JOIN cabinet_application_access_bindings binding
      ON binding.application_id = application.application_id
    JOIN cabinet_access_resolution_receipts access
      ON access.resolution_id = binding.access_resolution_id
    JOIN lead_requests lead ON lead.id = application.source_lead_id
    JOIN lead_partner_attribution attribution
      ON attribution.lead_id = lead.id
    JOIN cabinet_offer_publication_receipts publication
      ON publication.publication_id = application.offer_cycle_id
    WHERE application.application_id = NEW.application_id
      AND result.result_id = NEW.result_id
      AND application.source_lead_id = NEW.source_lead_id
      AND application.offer_cycle_id = NEW.offer_cycle_id
      AND application.offer_code = NEW.offer_code
      AND application.owner_partner_profile_id = NEW.owner_partner_profile_id
      AND application.plan_code_at_creation = NEW.plan_code
      AND application.current_status = NEW.terminal_status
      AND result.owner_partner_profile_id = NEW.owner_partner_profile_id
      AND result.terminal_status = NEW.terminal_status
      AND result.result_code = NEW.result_code
      AND result.result_hash = NEW.result_hash
      AND result.occurred_at = NEW.occurred_at
      AND binding.source_lead_id = NEW.source_lead_id
      AND binding.offer_cycle_id = NEW.offer_cycle_id
      AND binding.subject_telegram_id = application.subject_telegram_id
      AND binding.access_resolution_id = NEW.access_resolution_id
      AND binding.plan_code = NEW.plan_code
      AND binding.access_state = NEW.access_state
      AND access.subject_telegram_id = application.subject_telegram_id
      AND access.plan_code = NEW.plan_code
      AND access.access_state = NEW.access_state
      AND lead.telegram_id = application.subject_telegram_id
      AND lead.offer_code = NEW.offer_code
      AND attribution.partner_profile_id = NEW.owner_partner_profile_id
      AND publication.offer_code = NEW.offer_code
      AND publication.offer_version_id = application.offer_version_id
      AND publication.owner_partner_profile_id = NEW.owner_partner_profile_id
  ) THEN RAISE(ABORT, 'application analytics journey mismatch') END;

  SELECT CASE WHEN EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM canonical_analytics_events event
    WHERE event.event_id = NEW.event_id OR event.event_key = NEW.event_key
  ) THEN RAISE(ABORT, 'application analytics event already exists') END;
END

objects.name: trg_cabinet_assignment_validate
objects.sql:
CREATE TRIGGER trg_cabinet_assignment_validate
BEFORE INSERT ON cabinet_application_assignment_receipts
WHEN NOT EXISTS (
  SELECT 1 FROM cabinet_application_assignment_receipts existing
  WHERE existing.idempotency_key = NEW.idempotency_key
)
BEGIN
  SELECT CASE WHEN NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM cabinet_v1_settings cabinet,
      cabinet_application_v1_settings settings
    WHERE cabinet.id = 1 AND cabinet.rollout_mode = 'admin_shadow'
      AND cabinet.master_enabled = 1 AND cabinet.application_enabled = 1
      AND settings.id = 1 AND settings.enabled = 1
      AND settings.lifecycle_enabled = 1 AND settings.crm_enabled = 1
      AND settings.assignment_enabled = 1
  ) THEN RAISE(ABORT, 'application assignment gate is closed') END;

  SELECT CASE WHEN NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM cabinet_applications application
    JOIN cabinet_application_assignments assignment
      ON assignment.application_id = application.application_id
    JOIN partner_profiles owner_profile
      ON owner_profile.id = application.owner_partner_profile_id
    WHERE application.application_id = NEW.application_id
      AND application.owner_partner_profile_id = NEW.owner_partner_profile_id
      AND application.current_status != 'archived'
      AND assignment.revision = NEW.expected_revision
      AND assignment.assignee_telegram_id IS NEW.from_assignee_telegram_id
      AND NEW.revision_after = assignment.revision + 1
      AND NEW.occurred_at >= assignment.updated_at
      AND (NEW.to_assignee_telegram_id IS NULL
        OR NEW.to_assignee_telegram_id = owner_profile.telegram_id)
      AND (
        (NEW.actor_role = 'partner'
          AND owner_profile.telegram_id = NEW.actor_telegram_id
          AND owner_profile.status = 'active'
          AND EXISTS (
            SELECT 1 FROM user_roles role
            WHERE role.telegram_id = NEW.actor_telegram_id
              AND role.role = 'partner' AND role.status = 'active'
          ))
        OR
        (NEW.actor_role = 'admin' AND EXISTS (
          SELECT 1 FROM user_roles role
          WHERE role.telegram_id = NEW.actor_telegram_id
            AND role.role = 'admin' AND role.status = 'active'
        ))
      )
  ) THEN RAISE(ABORT, 'application assignment authority mismatch') END;

  SELECT CASE WHEN EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM cabinet_capability_grants grant_row
    JOIN cabinet_applications application
      ON application.application_id = NEW.application_id
    WHERE grant_row.actor_telegram_id = NEW.actor_telegram_id
      AND grant_row.capability_code = 'application.update'
      AND grant_row.effect = 'deny'
      AND grant_row.starts_at <= NEW.occurred_at
      AND (grant_row.expires_at IS NULL OR grant_row.expires_at > NEW.occurred_at)
      AND (
        grant_row.scope_rule = 'global'
        OR (grant_row.scope_rule = 'resource'
          AND grant_row.resource_id = application.resource_id)
        OR (NEW.actor_role = 'partner'
          AND grant_row.scope_rule IN ('self', 'partner_owner'))
      )
      AND NOT EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM cabinet_capability_grant_revocations revocation
        WHERE revocation.grant_id = grant_row.grant_id
          AND revocation.revoked_at <= NEW.occurred_at
      )
  ) THEN RAISE(ABORT, 'application update capability denied') END;
END

objects.name: trg_cabinet_application_create_validate
objects.sql:
CREATE TRIGGER trg_cabinet_application_create_validate
BEFORE INSERT ON cabinet_application_create_receipts
WHEN NOT EXISTS (
  SELECT 1 FROM cabinet_application_create_receipts existing
  WHERE existing.idempotency_key = NEW.idempotency_key
)
BEGIN
  SELECT CASE WHEN NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM cabinet_v1_settings cabinet, cabinet_offer_v1_settings offer_settings,
      cabinet_application_v1_settings application_settings,
      partner_beta_settings beta
    WHERE cabinet.id = 1 AND cabinet.rollout_mode = 'admin_shadow'
      AND cabinet.master_enabled = 1 AND cabinet.application_enabled = 1
      AND offer_settings.id = 1 AND offer_settings.enabled = 1
      AND offer_settings.lifecycle_enabled = 1
      AND offer_settings.publication_enabled = 1
      AND application_settings.id = 1 AND application_settings.enabled = 1
      AND application_settings.lifecycle_enabled = 1
      AND application_settings.crm_enabled = 1
      AND application_settings.contacts_enabled = 1
      AND beta.id = 1 AND beta.enabled = 1
      AND beta.public_visibility_enabled = 1
  ) THEN RAISE(ABORT, 'application create gate is closed') END;

  SELECT CASE WHEN NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM users subject
    JOIN user_roles subject_role ON subject_role.telegram_id = subject.telegram_id
      AND subject_role.role = 'user' AND subject_role.status = 'active'
    WHERE subject.telegram_id = NEW.subject_telegram_id
      AND subject.is_blocked = 0
      AND (
        (NEW.actor_role = 'user'
          AND NEW.actor_telegram_id = NEW.subject_telegram_id)
        OR
        (NEW.actor_role = 'admin' AND EXISTS (
          SELECT 1 FROM user_roles admin_role
          WHERE admin_role.telegram_id = NEW.actor_telegram_id
            AND admin_role.role = 'admin' AND admin_role.status = 'active'
        ))
      )
  ) THEN RAISE(ABORT, 'application create actor mismatch') END;

  SELECT CASE WHEN EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM cabinet_capability_grants grant_row
    WHERE grant_row.actor_telegram_id = NEW.actor_telegram_id
      AND grant_row.capability_code = 'application.create'
      AND grant_row.effect = 'deny'
      AND grant_row.starts_at <= NEW.created_at
      AND (grant_row.expires_at IS NULL OR grant_row.expires_at > NEW.created_at)
      AND grant_row.scope_rule IN ('global', 'self')
      AND NOT EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM cabinet_capability_grant_revocations revocation
        WHERE revocation.grant_id = grant_row.grant_id
          AND revocation.revoked_at <= NEW.created_at
      )
  ) THEN RAISE(ABORT, 'application create capability denied') END;

  SELECT CASE WHEN NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM lead_requests lead
    JOIN lead_partner_attribution attribution
      ON attribution.lead_id = lead.id
    JOIN cabinet_offer_publication_receipts publication
      ON publication.publication_id = NEW.offer_cycle_id
    JOIN cabinet_offer_review_receipts review
      ON review.review_id = publication.review_id
    JOIN cabinet_offer_submissions submission
      ON submission.submission_id = review.submission_id
    JOIN offer_visibility_rules visibility
      ON visibility.offer_code = publication.offer_code
    JOIN offer_owners owner ON owner.offer_code = publication.offer_code
    JOIN partner_profiles profile ON profile.id = owner.partner_profile_id
    JOIN user_roles partner_role ON partner_role.telegram_id = profile.telegram_id
      AND partner_role.role = 'partner' AND partner_role.status = 'active'
    JOIN partner_beta_access beta_access
      ON beta_access.partner_profile_id = profile.id
    JOIN partner_offer_links selection
      ON selection.offer_code = publication.offer_code
    JOIN partner_links partner_link ON partner_link.id = selection.partner_link_id
    JOIN program_offers program_offer
      ON program_offer.id = partner_link.catalog_offer_id
    JOIN partner_programs program ON program.code = program_offer.program_code
    JOIN offers catalog_offer ON catalog_offer.code = program_offer.offer_code
    WHERE lead.id = NEW.source_lead_id
      AND lead.telegram_id = NEW.subject_telegram_id
      AND lead.offer_code = NEW.offer_code
      AND lead.status = 'pending'
      AND lead.telegram_id != profile.telegram_id
      AND publication.offer_code = NEW.offer_code
      AND publication.offer_version_id = NEW.offer_version_id
      AND publication.owner_partner_profile_id = NEW.owner_partner_profile_id
      AND publication.authority_hash = NEW.offer_authority_hash
      AND review.decision = 'approved'
      AND submission.offer_code = NEW.offer_code
      AND submission.offer_version_id = NEW.offer_version_id
      AND submission.owner_partner_profile_id = NEW.owner_partner_profile_id
      AND submission.partner_link_id = NEW.partner_link_id
      AND submission.program_code = NEW.program_code
      AND visibility.moderation_status = 'approved'
      AND visibility.visibility = 'public'
      AND visibility.current_version_id = NEW.offer_version_id
      AND visibility.approved_version_id = NEW.offer_version_id
      AND owner.owner_kind = 'partner'
      AND owner.partner_profile_id = NEW.owner_partner_profile_id
      AND profile.telegram_id = NEW.owner_telegram_id
      AND profile.status = 'active'
      AND beta_access.access_status = 'active'
      AND (beta_access.expires_at IS NULL
        OR unixepoch(beta_access.expires_at) > NEW.created_at)
      AND selection.partner_link_id = NEW.partner_link_id
      AND partner_link.partner_profile_id = NEW.owner_partner_profile_id
      AND partner_link.status = 'approved'
      AND partner_link.ownership_confirmed = 1
      AND partner_link.traffic_confirmed = 1
      AND program_offer.program_code = NEW.program_code
      AND program_offer.status = 'active'
      AND program.status = 'active'
      AND catalog_offer.status = 'active'
      AND attribution.partner_link_id = NEW.partner_link_id
      AND attribution.partner_profile_id = NEW.owner_partner_profile_id
      AND attribution.program_code = NEW.program_code
  ) THEN RAISE(ABORT, 'application source or offer authority mismatch') END;

  SELECT CASE WHEN NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM cabinet_plan_quotas quota
    JOIN cabinet_tariff_capacity capacity
      ON capacity.plan_code = quota.plan_code
    WHERE quota.plan_code = NEW.plan_code
      AND quota.quota_code = 'active_applications'
      AND quota.window_kind = 'concurrent'
      AND quota.source_kind = 'fixed_product_override'
      AND quota.quota_version = 1
      AND quota.limit_value = NEW.quota_limit
      AND ((NEW.plan_code = 'free' AND NEW.quota_limit = 5
          AND capacity.capacity_percent = 10)
        OR (NEW.plan_code = 'professional' AND NEW.quota_limit = 25
          AND capacity.capacity_percent = 50)
        OR (NEW.plan_code = 'dragon' AND NEW.quota_limit = 50
          AND capacity.capacity_percent = 100))
  ) THEN RAISE(ABORT, 'application quota authority mismatch') END;

  SELECT CASE WHEN (
    SELECT COUNT(*)
    FROM cabinet_applications application
    JOIN cabinet_application_status_registry status
      ON status.status_code = application.current_status
      AND status.contract_version = application.transition_contract_version
    WHERE application.subject_telegram_id = NEW.subject_telegram_id
      AND status.active_slot = 1
  ) >= NEW.quota_limit
  THEN RAISE(ABORT, 'active application quota exhausted') END;
END

      AND receipt.application_id = NEW.application_id

objects.name: trg_cabinet_application_note_validate

CREATE TRIGGER trg_cabinet_application_note_validate
BEFORE INSERT ON cabinet_application_notes_private
WHEN NOT EXISTS (
  SELECT 1 FROM cabinet_application_notes_private existing
  WHERE existing.idempotency_key = NEW.idempotency_key
)
BEGIN
  SELECT CASE WHEN NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM cabinet_v1_settings cabinet,
      cabinet_application_v1_settings settings
    WHERE cabinet.id = 1 AND cabinet.rollout_mode = 'admin_shadow'
      AND cabinet.master_enabled = 1 AND cabinet.application_enabled = 1
      AND settings.id = 1 AND settings.enabled = 1
      AND settings.lifecycle_enabled = 1 AND settings.crm_enabled = 1
      AND settings.notes_enabled = 1
  ) THEN RAISE(ABORT, 'application note gate is closed') END;

  SELECT CASE WHEN NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM cabinet_applications application
    WHERE application.application_id = NEW.application_id
      AND application.owner_partner_profile_id = NEW.owner_partner_profile_id
      AND application.revision = NEW.application_revision
      AND application.current_status != 'archived'
      AND NEW.occurred_at >= application.updated_at
      AND (
        (NEW.author_role = 'partner' AND EXISTS (
          SELECT 1 FROM partner_profiles profile
          JOIN user_roles role ON role.telegram_id = profile.telegram_id
          WHERE profile.id = application.owner_partner_profile_id
            AND profile.telegram_id = NEW.author_telegram_id
            AND profile.status = 'active'
            AND role.role = 'partner' AND role.status = 'active'
        ))
        OR
        (NEW.author_role = 'admin' AND EXISTS (
          SELECT 1 FROM user_roles role
          WHERE role.telegram_id = NEW.author_telegram_id
            AND role.role = 'admin' AND role.status = 'active'
        ))
      )
  ) THEN RAISE(ABORT, 'application note actor or revision mismatch') END;

  SELECT CASE WHEN EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM cabinet_capability_grants grant_row
    JOIN cabinet_applications application
      ON application.application_id = NEW.application_id
    WHERE grant_row.actor_telegram_id = NEW.author_telegram_id
      AND grant_row.capability_code = 'application.update'
      AND grant_row.effect = 'deny'
      AND grant_row.starts_at <= NEW.occurred_at
      AND (grant_row.expires_at IS NULL OR grant_row.expires_at > NEW.occurred_at)
      AND (
        grant_row.scope_rule = 'global'
        OR (grant_row.scope_rule = 'resource'
          AND grant_row.resource_id = application.resource_id)
        OR (NEW.author_role = 'partner'
          AND grant_row.scope_rule IN ('self', 'partner_owner'))
      )
      AND NOT EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM cabinet_capability_grant_revocations revocation
        WHERE revocation.grant_id = grant_row.grant_id
          AND revocation.revoked_at <= NEW.occurred_at
      )
  ) THEN RAISE(ABORT, 'application update capability denied') END;
END

objects.name: trg_cabinet_offer_preview_validate
objects.sql:
CREATE TRIGGER trg_cabinet_offer_preview_validate
BEFORE INSERT ON cabinet_offer_preview_receipts
BEGIN
  SELECT CASE WHEN NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM cabinet_v1_settings c, cabinet_offer_v1_settings s
    WHERE c.id = 1 AND c.rollout_mode = 'admin_shadow'
      AND c.master_enabled = 1 AND c.offer_enabled = 1
      AND s.id = 1 AND s.enabled = 1 AND s.lifecycle_enabled = 1
      AND s.preview_enabled = 1
  ) THEN RAISE(ABORT, 'offer preview gate is closed') END;
  SELECT CASE WHEN NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM offer_versions v
    WHERE v.id = NEW.offer_version_id AND v.offer_code = NEW.offer_code
      AND (v.content_hash = NEW.version_content_hash
        OR v.content_hash = 'sha256:' || NEW.version_content_hash)
  ) THEN RAISE(ABORT, 'offer preview version mismatch') END;
  SELECT CASE WHEN NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM offer_owners ow
    JOIN partner_profiles pf ON pf.id = ow.partner_profile_id
    JOIN user_roles ur ON ur.telegram_id = pf.telegram_id
      AND ur.role = 'partner' AND ur.status = 'active'
    JOIN partner_beta_access ba ON ba.partner_profile_id = pf.id
    JOIN partner_offer_links selection ON selection.offer_code = ow.offer_code
    JOIN partner_links pl ON pl.id = selection.partner_link_id
    JOIN program_offers po ON po.id = pl.catalog_offer_id
    JOIN partner_programs pp ON pp.code = po.program_code
    JOIN offers base ON base.code = po.offer_code
    WHERE ow.offer_code = NEW.offer_code AND ow.owner_kind = 'partner'
      AND pf.status = 'active' AND ba.access_status = 'active'
      AND (ba.expires_at IS NULL OR unixepoch(ba.expires_at) > NEW.occurred_at)
      AND pl.partner_profile_id = pf.id AND pl.status = 'approved'
      AND pl.ownership_confirmed = 1 AND pl.traffic_confirmed = 1
      AND po.status = 'active' AND pp.status = 'active' AND base.status = 'active'
  ) THEN RAISE(ABORT, 'offer preview authority mismatch') END;
  SELECT CASE WHEN NEW.audience_kind = 'owner' AND NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM offer_owners ow
    JOIN partner_profiles pf ON pf.id = ow.partner_profile_id
    JOIN offer_visibility_rules vr ON vr.offer_code = ow.offer_code
    WHERE ow.offer_code = NEW.offer_code AND ow.owner_kind = 'partner'
      AND pf.status = 'active' AND pf.telegram_id = NEW.viewer_telegram_id
      AND vr.current_version_id = NEW.offer_version_id
  ) THEN RAISE(ABORT, 'owner preview denied') END;
  SELECT CASE WHEN NEW.audience_kind = 'moderator' AND NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM user_roles ur
    JOIN offer_visibility_rules vr ON vr.offer_code = NEW.offer_code
    WHERE ur.telegram_id = NEW.viewer_telegram_id
      AND ur.role = 'admin' AND ur.status = 'active'
      AND vr.submitted_version_id = NEW.offer_version_id
  ) THEN RAISE(ABORT, 'moderator preview denied') END;
  SELECT CASE WHEN NEW.audience_kind = 'user' AND NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM offer_visibility_rules vr
    WHERE vr.offer_code = NEW.offer_code
      AND vr.moderation_status = 'approved' AND vr.visibility = 'public'
      AND vr.current_version_id = NEW.offer_version_id
      AND vr.approved_version_id = NEW.offer_version_id
  ) THEN RAISE(ABORT, 'public preview denied') END;
END

objects.name: trg_cabinet_offer_publication_validate
objects.sql:
CREATE TRIGGER trg_cabinet_offer_publication_validate
BEFORE INSERT ON cabinet_offer_publication_receipts
WHEN NOT EXISTS (
  SELECT 1 FROM cabinet_offer_publication_receipts
  WHERE idempotency_key = NEW.idempotency_key
)
BEGIN
  SELECT CASE WHEN NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM cabinet_v1_settings c, cabinet_offer_v1_settings s,
      partner_beta_settings b
    WHERE c.id = 1 AND c.rollout_mode = 'admin_shadow'
      AND c.master_enabled = 1 AND c.offer_enabled = 1
      AND s.id = 1 AND s.enabled = 1 AND s.lifecycle_enabled = 1
      AND s.publication_enabled = 1
      AND b.id = 1 AND b.enabled = 1 AND b.private_offers_enabled = 1
      AND b.public_visibility_enabled = 1
  ) THEN RAISE(ABORT, 'offer publication gate is closed') END;
  SELECT CASE WHEN NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM cabinet_offer_review_receipts r
    JOIN cabinet_offer_submissions s ON s.submission_id = r.submission_id
    JOIN offer_visibility_rules vr ON vr.offer_code = s.offer_code
    JOIN offer_owners ow ON ow.offer_code = s.offer_code
    JOIN partner_profiles pf ON pf.id = ow.partner_profile_id
    JOIN user_roles ur ON ur.telegram_id = pf.telegram_id
      AND ur.role = 'partner' AND ur.status = 'active'
    JOIN partner_beta_access ba ON ba.partner_profile_id = pf.id
    JOIN partner_offer_links selection ON selection.offer_code = s.offer_code
    JOIN partner_links pl ON pl.id = selection.partner_link_id
    JOIN program_offers po ON po.id = pl.catalog_offer_id
    JOIN partner_programs pp ON pp.code = po.program_code
    JOIN offers base ON base.code = po.offer_code
    WHERE r.review_id = NEW.review_id AND r.decision = 'approved'
      AND s.offer_code = NEW.offer_code
      AND s.offer_version_id = NEW.offer_version_id
      AND s.owner_partner_profile_id = NEW.owner_partner_profile_id
      AND s.version_content_hash = NEW.content_hash
      AND s.authority_hash = NEW.authority_hash
      AND s.media_set_hash = NEW.media_set_hash
      AND r.reviewed_content_hash = NEW.content_hash
      AND r.reviewed_authority_hash = NEW.authority_hash
      AND r.approved_media_set_hash = NEW.media_set_hash
      AND vr.moderation_status = 'approved' AND vr.visibility = 'private'
      AND vr.current_version_id = NEW.offer_version_id
      AND vr.submitted_version_id = NEW.offer_version_id
      AND vr.approved_version_id = NEW.offer_version_id
      AND ow.owner_kind = 'partner' AND ow.partner_profile_id = pf.id
      AND pf.status = 'active' AND pf.telegram_id = NEW.published_by
      AND ba.access_status = 'active'
      AND (ba.expires_at IS NULL OR unixepoch(ba.expires_at) > NEW.published_at)
      AND selection.partner_link_id = s.partner_link_id
      AND pl.partner_profile_id = pf.id AND pl.status = 'approved'
      AND pl.ownership_confirmed = 1 AND pl.traffic_confirmed = 1
      AND po.id = s.program_offer_id AND po.program_code = s.program_code
      AND po.status = 'active' AND pp.status = 'active' AND base.status = 'active'
  ) THEN RAISE(ABORT, 'offer publication authority mismatch') END;
  SELECT CASE WHEN EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM cabinet_offer_version_media m
    WHERE m.offer_code = NEW.offer_code
      AND m.offer_version_id = NEW.offer_version_id
      AND NOT EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM cabinet_offer_media_approvals a
        WHERE a.media_id = m.media_id AND a.review_id = NEW.review_id
          AND a.content_hash = m.content_hash
      )
  ) THEN RAISE(ABORT, 'offer publication has unapproved media') END;
END

CREATE TRIGGER trg_cabinet_offer_review_validate
BEFORE INSERT ON cabinet_offer_review_receipts
WHEN NOT EXISTS (
  SELECT 1 FROM cabinet_offer_review_receipts
  WHERE idempotency_key = NEW.idempotency_key
)
BEGIN
  SELECT CASE WHEN NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM cabinet_v1_settings c, cabinet_offer_v1_settings s
    WHERE c.id = 1 AND c.rollout_mode = 'admin_shadow'
      AND c.master_enabled = 1 AND c.offer_enabled = 1
      AND s.id = 1 AND s.enabled = 1 AND s.lifecycle_enabled = 1
      AND s.moderation_enabled = 1
  ) THEN RAISE(ABORT, 'offer review gate is closed') END;
  SELECT CASE WHEN NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM user_roles
    WHERE telegram_id = NEW.reviewed_by
      AND role = 'admin' AND status = 'active'
  ) THEN RAISE(ABORT, 'offer review requires active admin') END;
  SELECT CASE WHEN NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM cabinet_offer_submissions s
    JOIN offer_moderation_decisions md ON md.id = NEW.moderation_decision_id
    JOIN offer_visibility_rules vr ON vr.offer_code = s.offer_code
    WHERE s.submission_id = NEW.submission_id
      AND md.offer_code = s.offer_code
      AND md.offer_version_id = s.offer_version_id
      AND md.decision = NEW.decision AND md.actor_id = NEW.reviewed_by
      AND md.actor_role = 'admin'
      AND vr.current_version_id = s.offer_version_id
      AND vr.submitted_version_id = s.offer_version_id
      AND vr.moderation_status = NEW.decision
      AND vr.visibility = 'private'
      AND ((NEW.decision = 'approved'
          AND vr.approved_version_id = s.offer_version_id)
        OR (NEW.decision != 'approved'
          AND vr.approved_version_id IS NULL))
      AND s.version_content_hash = NEW.reviewed_content_hash
      AND s.authority_hash = NEW.reviewed_authority_hash
      AND s.media_set_hash = NEW.approved_media_set_hash
  ) THEN RAISE(ABORT, 'offer review binding mismatch') END;
  SELECT CASE WHEN NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM cabinet_offer_submissions s
    JOIN offer_owners ow ON ow.offer_code = s.offer_code
    JOIN partner_profiles pf ON pf.id = ow.partner_profile_id
    JOIN user_roles ur ON ur.telegram_id = pf.telegram_id
      AND ur.role = 'partner' AND ur.status = 'active'
    JOIN partner_beta_access ba ON ba.partner_profile_id = pf.id
    JOIN partner_offer_links selection ON selection.offer_code = s.offer_code
    JOIN partner_links pl ON pl.id = selection.partner_link_id
    JOIN program_offers po ON po.id = pl.catalog_offer_id
    JOIN partner_programs pp ON pp.code = po.program_code
    JOIN offers base ON base.code = po.offer_code
    WHERE s.submission_id = NEW.submission_id
      AND pf.status = 'active' AND ba.access_status = 'active'
      AND selection.partner_link_id = s.partner_link_id
      AND pl.partner_profile_id = pf.id AND pl.status = 'approved'
      AND pl.ownership_confirmed = 1 AND pl.traffic_confirmed = 1
      AND po.id = s.program_offer_id AND po.program_code = s.program_code
      AND po.status = 'active' AND pp.status = 'active' AND base.status = 'active'
  ) THEN RAISE(ABORT, 'reviewed offer authority changed') END;
END

objects.name: trg_cabinet_offer_submission_validate
objects.sql:
CREATE TRIGGER trg_cabinet_offer_submission_validate
BEFORE INSERT ON cabinet_offer_submissions
WHEN NOT EXISTS (
  SELECT 1 FROM cabinet_offer_submissions
  WHERE idempotency_key = NEW.idempotency_key
)
BEGIN
  SELECT CASE WHEN NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM cabinet_v1_settings c, cabinet_offer_v1_settings s
    WHERE c.id = 1 AND c.rollout_mode = 'admin_shadow'
      AND c.master_enabled = 1 AND c.offer_enabled = 1
      AND s.id = 1 AND s.enabled = 1 AND s.lifecycle_enabled = 1
      AND s.moderation_enabled = 1
  ) THEN RAISE(ABORT, 'offer submission gate is closed') END;
  SELECT CASE WHEN NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM offer_versions v
    JOIN offer_visibility_rules vr ON vr.offer_code = v.offer_code
    JOIN offer_owners ow ON ow.offer_code = v.offer_code
    JOIN partner_profiles pf ON pf.id = ow.partner_profile_id
    JOIN user_roles ur ON ur.telegram_id = pf.telegram_id
      AND ur.role = 'partner' AND ur.status = 'active'
    JOIN partner_beta_access ba ON ba.partner_profile_id = pf.id
    JOIN partner_offer_links selection ON selection.offer_code = v.offer_code
    JOIN partner_links pl ON pl.id = selection.partner_link_id
    JOIN program_offers po ON po.id = pl.catalog_offer_id
    JOIN partner_programs pp ON pp.code = po.program_code
    JOIN offers base ON base.code = po.offer_code
    JOIN offer_moderation_decisions md ON md.id = NEW.moderation_decision_id
    WHERE v.id = NEW.offer_version_id AND v.offer_code = NEW.offer_code
      AND (v.content_hash = NEW.version_content_hash
        OR v.content_hash = 'sha256:' || NEW.version_content_hash)
      AND v.business_status = 'active'
      AND vr.current_version_id = v.id AND vr.submitted_version_id = v.id
      AND vr.approved_version_id IS NULL
      AND vr.moderation_status = 'pending' AND vr.visibility = 'private'
      AND ow.owner_kind = 'partner'
      AND ow.partner_profile_id = NEW.owner_partner_profile_id
      AND pf.status = 'active' AND pf.telegram_id = NEW.submitted_by
      AND ba.access_status = 'active' AND ba.can_submit_offers = 1
      AND (ba.expires_at IS NULL OR unixepoch(ba.expires_at) > NEW.submitted_at)
      AND selection.partner_link_id = NEW.partner_link_id
      AND pl.partner_profile_id = pf.id AND pl.status = 'approved'
      AND pl.ownership_confirmed = 1 AND pl.traffic_confirmed = 1
      AND po.id = NEW.program_offer_id AND po.program_code = NEW.program_code
      AND po.status = 'active' AND pp.status = 'active' AND base.status = 'active'
      AND md.offer_code = NEW.offer_code AND md.offer_version_id = v.id
      AND md.decision = 'submitted' AND md.actor_id = NEW.submitted_by
      AND md.actor_role = 'partner'
  ) THEN RAISE(ABORT, 'offer submission authority mismatch') END;
END

objects.name: trg_cabinet_offer_media_validate
objects.sql:
CREATE TRIGGER trg_cabinet_offer_media_validate
BEFORE INSERT ON cabinet_offer_version_media
BEGIN
  SELECT CASE WHEN NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM cabinet_v1_settings c, cabinet_offer_v1_settings s
    WHERE c.id = 1 AND c.rollout_mode = 'admin_shadow'
      AND c.master_enabled = 1 AND c.offer_enabled = 1
      AND s.id = 1 AND s.enabled = 1 AND s.lifecycle_enabled = 1
  ) THEN RAISE(ABORT, 'offer media gate is closed') END;
  SELECT CASE WHEN NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM offer_versions v
    JOIN offer_visibility_rules vr ON vr.offer_code = v.offer_code
    JOIN offer_owners ow ON ow.offer_code = v.offer_code
    JOIN partner_profiles pf ON pf.id = ow.partner_profile_id
    JOIN user_roles ur ON ur.telegram_id = pf.telegram_id
      AND ur.role = 'partner' AND ur.status = 'active'
    JOIN partner_beta_access ba ON ba.partner_profile_id = pf.id
    JOIN partner_offer_links selection ON selection.offer_code = ow.offer_code
    JOIN partner_links pl ON pl.id = selection.partner_link_id
    JOIN program_offers po ON po.id = pl.catalog_offer_id
    JOIN partner_programs pp ON pp.code = po.program_code
    JOIN offers base ON base.code = po.offer_code
    WHERE v.id = NEW.offer_version_id AND v.offer_code = NEW.offer_code
      AND vr.current_version_id = v.id AND vr.moderation_status != 'pending'
      AND vr.approved_version_id IS NULL
      AND NOT EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM cabinet_offer_submissions s
        WHERE s.offer_version_id = v.id
      )
      AND ow.owner_kind = 'partner' AND pf.status = 'active'
      AND ba.access_status = 'active' AND ba.can_create_private_offers = 1
      AND (ba.expires_at IS NULL OR unixepoch(ba.expires_at) > NEW.created_at)
      AND pl.partner_profile_id = pf.id AND pl.status = 'approved'
      AND pl.ownership_confirmed = 1 AND pl.traffic_confirmed = 1
      AND po.status = 'active' AND pp.status = 'active' AND base.status = 'active'
      AND (
        EXISTS (
          SELECT 1 FROM user_roles ur
          WHERE ur.telegram_id = NEW.uploaded_by
            AND ur.role = 'admin' AND ur.status = 'active'
        )
        OR (ow.owner_kind = 'partner' AND pf.status = 'active'
          AND pf.telegram_id = NEW.uploaded_by)
      )
  ) THEN RAISE(ABORT, 'offer media authority mismatch') END;
END

objects.name: trg_cabinet_promotion_application_validate
objects.sql:
CREATE TRIGGER trg_cabinet_promotion_application_validate
BEFORE INSERT ON cabinet_promotion_application_receipts
BEGIN
  SELECT CASE WHEN NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM cabinet_promotion_evaluation_receipts e
    JOIN cabinet_promotion_windows w ON w.window_id = e.promotion_window_id
    JOIN cabinet_promotion_policies p ON p.policy_code = e.selected_policy_code
    JOIN offer_visibility_rules vr ON vr.offer_code = e.offer_code
    JOIN offer_owners ow ON ow.offer_code = e.offer_code
    JOIN partner_profiles pf ON pf.id = ow.partner_profile_id
    JOIN partner_offer_links selection ON selection.offer_code = ow.offer_code
    JOIN partner_links pl ON pl.id = selection.partner_link_id
    JOIN program_offers po ON po.id = pl.catalog_offer_id
    JOIN partner_programs pp ON pp.code = po.program_code
    JOIN offers base ON base.code = po.offer_code
    WHERE e.evaluation_id = NEW.evaluation_id
      AND e.outcome = 'eligible' AND e.reason_code = 'eligible'
      AND e.subject_telegram_id = NEW.subject_telegram_id
      AND e.offer_code = NEW.offer_code
      AND e.selected_policy_code = NEW.policy_code
      AND e.promotion_window_id = NEW.promotion_window_id
      AND e.checkout_intent_hash = NEW.checkout_intent_hash
      AND e.price_authority_key_hash = NEW.price_authority_key_hash
      AND e.price_version_hash = NEW.price_version_hash
      AND e.currency = NEW.currency
      AND e.base_price_stars = NEW.base_price_stars
      AND e.discount_basis_points = NEW.discount_basis_points
      AND e.discount_stars = NEW.discount_stars
      AND e.final_price_stars = NEW.final_price_stars
      AND NEW.applied_at >= w.starts_at AND NEW.applied_at < w.ends_at
      AND p.discount_basis_points = NEW.discount_basis_points
      AND vr.moderation_status = 'approved' AND vr.visibility = 'public'
      AND vr.current_version_id = vr.approved_version_id
      AND ow.owner_kind = 'partner' AND pf.status = 'active'
      AND pf.telegram_id != NEW.subject_telegram_id
      AND pl.partner_profile_id = pf.id AND pl.status = 'approved'
      AND pl.ownership_confirmed = 1 AND pl.traffic_confirmed = 1
      AND po.status = 'active' AND pp.status = 'active' AND base.status = 'active'
      AND (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT a.subject_telegram_id)
           FROM cabinet_promotion_application_receipts a
           WHERE a.promotion_window_id = w.window_id) < w.eligible_user_limit
  ) THEN RAISE(ABORT, 'promotion application authority mismatch') END;
END

objects.name: trg_cabinet_promotion_evaluation_validate
objects.sql:
CREATE TRIGGER trg_cabinet_promotion_evaluation_validate
BEFORE INSERT ON cabinet_promotion_evaluation_receipts
BEGIN
  SELECT CASE WHEN NEW.actor_telegram_id != NEW.subject_telegram_id OR NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM users u
    JOIN user_roles ur ON ur.telegram_id = u.telegram_id
    WHERE u.telegram_id = NEW.subject_telegram_id AND u.is_blocked = 0
      AND ur.role = 'user' AND ur.status = 'active'
  ) THEN RAISE(ABORT, 'promotion evaluation requires active self') END;
  SELECT CASE WHEN NEW.outcome = 'eligible' AND NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM cabinet_v1_settings c, cabinet_offer_v1_settings s,
      cabinet_promotion_windows w
    JOIN cabinet_promotion_policies p ON p.policy_code = w.policy_code
    JOIN offer_visibility_rules vr ON vr.offer_code = NEW.offer_code
    JOIN offer_owners ow ON ow.offer_code = NEW.offer_code
    JOIN partner_profiles pf ON pf.id = ow.partner_profile_id
    JOIN partner_offer_links selection ON selection.offer_code = ow.offer_code
    JOIN partner_links pl ON pl.id = selection.partner_link_id
    JOIN program_offers po ON po.id = pl.catalog_offer_id
    JOIN partner_programs pp ON pp.code = po.program_code
    JOIN offers base ON base.code = po.offer_code
    WHERE c.id = 1 AND c.rollout_mode = 'admin_shadow'
      AND c.master_enabled = 1 AND c.offer_enabled = 1
      AND s.id = 1 AND s.enabled = 1 AND s.lifecycle_enabled = 1
      AND s.promotions_enabled = 1
      AND w.window_id = NEW.promotion_window_id
      AND w.policy_code = NEW.selected_policy_code
      AND NEW.evaluated_at >= w.starts_at AND NEW.evaluated_at < w.ends_at
      AND p.discount_basis_points = NEW.discount_basis_points
      AND ((p.window_scope = 'user'
          AND w.subject_telegram_id = NEW.subject_telegram_id)
        OR (p.window_scope = 'global' AND w.subject_telegram_id IS NULL))
      AND vr.moderation_status = 'approved' AND vr.visibility = 'public'
      AND vr.current_version_id = vr.approved_version_id
      AND ow.owner_kind = 'partner' AND pf.status = 'active'
      AND pf.telegram_id != NEW.subject_telegram_id
      AND pl.partner_profile_id = pf.id AND pl.status = 'approved'
      AND pl.ownership_confirmed = 1 AND pl.traffic_confirmed = 1
      AND po.status = 'active' AND pp.status = 'active' AND base.status = 'active'
      AND (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT a.subject_telegram_id)
           FROM cabinet_promotion_application_receipts a
           WHERE a.promotion_window_id = w.window_id) < w.eligible_user_limit
  ) THEN RAISE(ABORT, 'eligible promotion authority mismatch') END;
  SELECT CASE WHEN NEW.outcome = 'eligible'
    AND NEW.selected_policy_code = 'newcomer_20_72h'
    AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM cabinet_promotion_application_receipts a
      WHERE a.policy_code = 'newcomer_20_72h'
        AND a.subject_telegram_id = NEW.subject_telegram_id
    ) THEN RAISE(ABORT, 'newcomer promotion already claimed') END;
END

objects.name: trg_cabinet_promotion_window_validate
objects.sql:
CREATE TRIGGER trg_cabinet_promotion_window_validate
BEFORE INSERT ON cabinet_promotion_windows
BEGIN
  SELECT CASE WHEN NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM cabinet_v1_settings c, cabinet_offer_v1_settings s
    WHERE c.id = 1 AND c.rollout_mode = 'admin_shadow'
      AND c.master_enabled = 1 AND c.offer_enabled = 1
      AND s.id = 1 AND s.enabled = 1 AND s.lifecycle_enabled = 1
      AND s.promotions_enabled = 1
  ) THEN RAISE(ABORT, 'promotion gate is closed') END;
  SELECT CASE WHEN NEW.source_kind = 'admin' AND NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM user_roles WHERE telegram_id = NEW.created_by
      AND role = 'admin' AND status = 'active'
  ) THEN RAISE(ABORT, 'promotion window requires active admin') END;
  SELECT CASE WHEN NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM cabinet_promotion_policies p
    WHERE p.policy_code = NEW.policy_code
      AND p.window_seconds = NEW.ends_at - NEW.starts_at
      AND p.eligible_user_limit = NEW.eligible_user_limit
      AND ((p.window_scope = 'user' AND NEW.subject_telegram_id IS NOT NULL)
        OR (p.window_scope = 'global' AND NEW.subject_telegram_id IS NULL))
  ) THEN RAISE(ABORT, 'promotion window policy mismatch') END;
  SELECT CASE WHEN NEW.policy_code = 'newcomer_20_72h' AND NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM users
    WHERE telegram_id = NEW.subject_telegram_id
      AND unixepoch(joined_at) = NEW.starts_at
  ) THEN RAISE(ABORT, 'newcomer window must bind account creation') END;
END
