objects.name: trg_referral_candidates_payment_guard
objects.sql:
CREATE TRIGGER trg_referral_candidates_payment_guard
BEFORE INSERT ON referral_reward_candidates
WHEN NOT EXISTS (
  SELECT 1
  FROM subscription_orders orders
  JOIN payment_ledger payment
    ON payment.order_id = orders.order_id
  JOIN subscription_access_grants access_grant
    ON access_grant.order_id = orders.order_id
  WHERE orders.order_id = NEW.source_order_id
    AND orders.telegram_id = NEW.buyer_telegram_id
    AND orders.plan_code = NEW.buyer_plan_code
    AND orders.amount_stars = NEW.amount_stars
    AND orders.order_state = 'applied'
    AND payment.ledger_entry_id = NEW.source_payment_ledger_entry_id
    AND payment.entry_type = 'payment'
    AND payment.direction = 'credit'
    AND payment.currency = 'XTR'
    AND payment.telegram_id = NEW.buyer_telegram_id
    AND payment.amount_stars = NEW.amount_stars
    AND payment.occurred_at = NEW.paid_at
    AND access_grant.grant_id = NEW.source_access_grant_id
    AND access_grant.payment_ledger_entry_id = payment.ledger_entry_id
    AND access_grant.telegram_id = NEW.buyer_telegram_id
    AND access_grant.plan_code = NEW.buyer_plan_code
    AND access_grant.status = 'active'
    AND NOT EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM payment_ledger compensation
      WHERE compensation.related_ledger_entry_id = payment.ledger_entry_id
        AND compensation.entry_type IN ('refund', 'chargeback')
    )
    AND NOT EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM payment_ledger earlier
      JOIN subscription_orders earlier_order
        ON earlier_order.order_id = earlier.order_id
      WHERE earlier.telegram_id = NEW.buyer_telegram_id
        AND earlier.entry_type = 'payment'
        AND earlier.direction = 'credit'
        AND earlier.currency = 'XTR'
        AND earlier_order.plan_code IN ('professional', 'dragon')
        AND (
          earlier.occurred_at < NEW.paid_at
          OR (earlier.occurred_at = NEW.paid_at
            AND earlier.ledger_entry_id < NEW.source_payment_ledger_entry_id)
        )
    )
)
BEGIN
  SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'candidate lacks first applied payment evidence');
END

CREATE TRIGGER trg_referral_notice_jobs_transition_guard
BEFORE INSERT ON referral_reward_notice_jobs

  SELECT 1
  FROM referral_reward_transitions transition
  JOIN referral_rewards reward ON reward.reward_id = transition.reward_id
  WHERE transition.transition_id = NEW.source_transition_id
    AND transition.reward_id = NEW.reward_id
    AND transition.bonus_grant_id IS NEW.bonus_grant_id
    AND reward.beneficiary_telegram_id = NEW.recipient_telegram_id
    AND (
      (NEW.notice_type = 'pending_review'
        AND transition.transition_scope = 'reward'
        AND transition.from_status = 'none'
        AND transition.to_status = 'pending')
      OR
      (NEW.notice_type = 'reward_confirmed'
        AND transition.transition_scope = 'reward'
        AND transition.to_status = 'confirmed')
      OR
      (NEW.notice_type = 'reward_cancelled'
        AND transition.transition_scope = 'reward'
        AND transition.to_status = 'cancelled')
      OR
      (NEW.notice_type = 'bonus_claimable'
        AND transition.transition_scope = 'bonus_grant'
        AND transition.from_status = 'none'
        AND transition.to_status = 'claimable')
      OR
      (NEW.notice_type = 'bonus_applied'
        AND transition.transition_scope = 'bonus_grant'
        AND transition.to_status = 'applied')
      OR
      (NEW.notice_type = 'claim_window_expired'
        AND transition.transition_scope = 'bonus_grant'
        AND transition.to_status = 'expired')
      OR
      (NEW.notice_type = 'bonus_manual_review'
        AND transition.transition_scope = 'bonus_grant'
        AND transition.to_status = 'manual_review')
    )
)
BEGIN
  SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'referral notice lacks its immutable transition');

BEFORE INSERT ON referral_reward_protection_checks

  SELECT 1
  FROM referral_rewards reward
  JOIN referral_reward_candidates candidate
    ON candidate.candidate_id = reward.candidate_id
  JOIN payment_ledger compensation
    ON compensation.ledger_entry_id = NEW.compensation_ledger_entry_id
  WHERE reward.reward_id = NEW.reward_id
    AND reward.candidate_id = NEW.candidate_id
    AND reward.reward_status = 'pending'
    AND reward.revision = NEW.reward_revision
    AND candidate.source_payment_ledger_entry_id =
      NEW.source_payment_ledger_entry_id
    AND candidate.source_access_grant_id = NEW.source_access_grant_id
    AND compensation.related_ledger_entry_id =
      candidate.source_payment_ledger_entry_id
    AND compensation.entry_type = NEW.reason_code
    AND compensation.direction = 'debit'
    AND compensation.currency = 'XTR'
    AND compensation.order_id = candidate.source_order_id
    AND compensation.telegram_id = candidate.buyer_telegram_id
    AND compensation.amount_stars = candidate.amount_stars
    AND compensation.recorded_at <= NEW.checked_at
)
BEGIN
  SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'cancellation check lacks compensation evidence');
END

objects.name: trg_referral_protection_checks_confirm_guard
objects.sql:
CREATE TRIGGER trg_referral_protection_checks_confirm_guard
BEFORE INSERT ON referral_reward_protection_checks
WHEN NEW.decision = 'confirm' AND NOT EXISTS (
  SELECT 1
  FROM referral_rewards reward
  JOIN referral_reward_candidates candidate
    ON candidate.candidate_id = reward.candidate_id
  JOIN subscription_orders orders
    ON orders.order_id = candidate.source_order_id
  JOIN payment_ledger payment
    ON payment.ledger_entry_id = candidate.source_payment_ledger_entry_id
  JOIN subscription_access_grants source_access
    ON source_access.grant_id = candidate.source_access_grant_id
  JOIN payment_reconciliation_runs reconciliation
    ON reconciliation.run_id = NEW.reconciliation_run_id
  JOIN payment_reconciliation_items reconciliation_item
    ON reconciliation_item.item_id = NEW.reconciliation_item_id
  WHERE reward.reward_id = NEW.reward_id
    AND reward.candidate_id = NEW.candidate_id
    AND reward.reward_status = 'pending'
    AND reward.revision = NEW.reward_revision
    AND NEW.checked_at >= reward.confirm_after
    AND candidate.candidate_id = NEW.candidate_id
    AND candidate.source_payment_ledger_entry_id =
      NEW.source_payment_ledger_entry_id
    AND candidate.source_access_grant_id = NEW.source_access_grant_id
    AND orders.order_state = 'applied'
    AND orders.telegram_id = candidate.buyer_telegram_id
    AND orders.plan_code = candidate.buyer_plan_code
    AND orders.amount_stars = candidate.amount_stars
    AND payment.order_id = candidate.source_order_id
    AND payment.telegram_id = candidate.buyer_telegram_id
    AND payment.entry_type = 'payment'
    AND payment.direction = 'credit'
    AND payment.currency = 'XTR'
    AND payment.amount_stars = candidate.amount_stars
    AND payment.occurred_at = candidate.paid_at
    AND source_access.payment_ledger_entry_id = payment.ledger_entry_id
    AND source_access.order_id = candidate.source_order_id
    AND source_access.telegram_id = candidate.buyer_telegram_id
    AND source_access.plan_code = candidate.buyer_plan_code
    AND source_access.status = 'active'
    AND reconciliation.status IN ('completed', 'manual_review')
    AND reconciliation.started_at >= reward.confirm_after
    AND reconciliation.finished_at IS NOT NULL
    AND reconciliation.finished_at <= NEW.recorded_at
    AND reconciliation_item.run_id = reconciliation.run_id
    AND reconciliation_item.ledger_entry_id = payment.ledger_entry_id
    AND reconciliation_item.observation_side = 'telegram'
    AND reconciliation_item.transaction_direction = 'incoming'
    AND reconciliation_item.telegram_id = candidate.buyer_telegram_id
    AND reconciliation_item.amount_stars = candidate.amount_stars
    AND ABS(reconciliation_item.transaction_date - candidate.paid_at) <= 86400
    AND reconciliation_item.local_state IN ('matched', 'recovered')
    AND reconciliation_item.observed_at >= reward.confirm_after
    AND reconciliation_item.observed_at <= NEW.checked_at
    AND NOT EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM payment_ledger compensation
      WHERE compensation.related_ledger_entry_id = payment.ledger_entry_id
        AND compensation.entry_type IN ('refund', 'chargeback')
    )
)
BEGIN
  SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'confirmation check lacks fresh payment evidence');
END

objects.name: trg_referral_transitions_apply_bonus
objects.sql:
CREATE TRIGGER trg_referral_transitions_apply_bonus
AFTER INSERT ON referral_reward_transitions
WHEN NEW.transition_scope = 'bonus_grant' AND NEW.from_status != 'none'
BEGIN
  UPDATE bonus_access_grants
  SET grant_status = NEW.to_status,
      claimed_at = CASE
        WHEN NEW.from_status = 'claimable' AND NEW.to_status = 'applied'
          THEN NEW.occurred_at
        ELSE claimed_at
      END,
      applied_at = CASE
        WHEN NEW.to_status = 'applied' THEN NEW.recorded_at
        ELSE applied_at
      END,
      starts_at = CASE
        WHEN NEW.to_status = 'applied' THEN NEW.effect_starts_at
        ELSE starts_at
      END,
      ends_at = CASE
        WHEN NEW.to_status = 'applied' THEN NEW.effect_ends_at
        ELSE ends_at
      END,
      compensation_ledger_entry_id = CASE
        WHEN NEW.reason_code IN ('refund', 'chargeback')
          THEN NEW.related_payment_ledger_entry_id
        ELSE compensation_ledger_entry_id
      END,
      compensated_seconds = CASE
        WHEN NEW.reason_code IN ('refund', 'chargeback')
          THEN NEW.compensated_seconds
        ELSE compensated_seconds
      END,
      compensated_at = CASE
        WHEN NEW.reason_code IN ('refund', 'chargeback')
          THEN NEW.recorded_at
        ELSE compensated_at
      END,
      last_transition_id = NEW.transition_id,
      revision = NEW.to_revision,
      updated_at = NEW.recorded_at
  WHERE bonus_grant_id = NEW.bonus_grant_id
    AND reward_id = NEW.reward_id
    AND grant_status = NEW.from_status
    AND revision = NEW.from_revision;
END

        ELSE cancelled_at
      END,
      last_transition_id = NEW.transition_id,

      WHERE reward.reward_id = NEW.reward_id
        AND reward.reward_status = NEW.to_status
        AND reward.revision = NEW.to_revision
        AND reward.last_transition_id IS NULL
    ))
    OR
    (NEW.from_status != 'none' AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM referral_rewards reward
      WHERE reward.reward_id = NEW.reward_id
        AND reward.reward_status = NEW.from_status
        AND reward.revision = NEW.from_revision
    ))
  ))
  OR
  (NEW.transition_scope = 'bonus_grant' AND (
    (NEW.from_status = 'none' AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM bonus_access_grants grant_record
      WHERE grant_record.bonus_grant_id = NEW.bonus_grant_id
        AND grant_record.reward_id = NEW.reward_id
        AND grant_record.grant_status = NEW.to_status
        AND grant_record.revision = NEW.to_revision
        AND grant_record.last_transition_id IS NULL
    ))
    OR
    (NEW.from_status != 'none' AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM bonus_access_grants grant_record
      WHERE grant_record.bonus_grant_id = NEW.bonus_grant_id
        AND grant_record.reward_id = NEW.reward_id
        AND grant_record.grant_status = NEW.from_status

    ))
  ))
)

objects.name: trg_referral_transitions_enqueue_notice
objects.sql:
CREATE TRIGGER trg_referral_transitions_enqueue_notice
AFTER INSERT ON referral_reward_transitions
WHEN
  (NEW.transition_scope = 'reward'
    AND NEW.from_status = 'none' AND NEW.to_status = 'pending')
  OR
  (NEW.transition_scope = 'reward'
    AND NEW.to_status IN ('confirmed', 'cancelled'))
  OR
  (NEW.transition_scope = 'bonus_grant'
    AND (
      (NEW.from_status = 'none' AND NEW.to_status = 'claimable')
      OR NEW.to_status IN ('applied', 'expired', 'manual_review')
    ))
BEGIN
  INSERT OR IGNORE INTO referral_reward_notice_jobs (
    notice_key, source_event_key, source_transition_id,
    source_expiry_event_id, reward_id, bonus_grant_id,
    recipient_telegram_id, notice_type, delivery_state,
    not_before, next_attempt_at, attempt_count,
    lease_token, lease_expires_at, last_attempt_at,
    inbox_recorded_at, delivered_at, last_error_code,
    created_at, updated_at
  )
  SELECT
    'referral-notice:' || NEW.transition_id,
    'transition:' || NEW.transition_id,
    NEW.transition_id,
    NULL,
    NEW.reward_id,
    NEW.bonus_grant_id,
    reward.beneficiary_telegram_id,
    CASE
      WHEN NEW.transition_scope = 'reward'
        AND NEW.from_status = 'none'
        AND NEW.to_status = 'pending' THEN 'pending_review'
      WHEN NEW.transition_scope = 'reward'
        AND NEW.to_status = 'confirmed' THEN 'reward_confirmed'
      WHEN NEW.transition_scope = 'reward'
        AND NEW.to_status = 'cancelled' THEN 'reward_cancelled'
      WHEN NEW.transition_scope = 'bonus_grant'
        AND NEW.from_status = 'none'
        AND NEW.to_status = 'claimable' THEN 'bonus_claimable'
      WHEN NEW.transition_scope = 'bonus_grant'
        AND NEW.to_status = 'applied' THEN 'bonus_applied'
      WHEN NEW.transition_scope = 'bonus_grant'
        AND NEW.to_status = 'expired' THEN 'claim_window_expired'
      WHEN NEW.transition_scope = 'bonus_grant'
        AND NEW.to_status = 'manual_review' THEN 'bonus_manual_review'
    END,
    'pending',
    CASE
      WHEN NEW.transition_scope = 'reward' AND NEW.to_status = 'confirmed'
        THEN NEW.recorded_at + 300
      ELSE NEW.recorded_at
    END,
    CASE
      WHEN NEW.transition_scope = 'reward' AND NEW.to_status = 'confirmed'
        THEN NEW.recorded_at + 300
      ELSE NEW.recorded_at
    END,
    0, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, '',
    NEW.recorded_at, NEW.recorded_at
  FROM referral_rewards reward
  WHERE reward.reward_id = NEW.reward_id;
END

CREATE TRIGGER trg_referral_transitions_late_compensation_guard
BEFORE INSERT ON referral_reward_transitions

  AND NEW.from_status = 'applied'
  AND NEW.to_status IN ('revoked', 'manual_review')
  AND (
    NEW.reason_code NOT IN ('refund', 'chargeback')
    OR NOT EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM bonus_access_grants grant_record
      WHERE grant_record.bonus_grant_id = NEW.bonus_grant_id
        AND (
          (NEW.to_status = 'revoked'
            AND NEW.recorded_at <= grant_record.starts_at
            AND NEW.compensated_seconds = grant_record.bonus_seconds)
          OR
          (NEW.to_status = 'manual_review'
            AND NEW.recorded_at > grant_record.starts_at
            AND NEW.compensated_seconds = 0)
        )
    )
  )

    FROM referral_rewards reward
    JOIN referral_reward_candidates candidate
      ON candidate.candidate_id = reward.candidate_id
    JOIN payment_ledger compensation
      ON compensation.ledger_entry_id = NEW.related_payment_ledger_entry_id
    WHERE reward.reward_id = NEW.reward_id
      AND compensation.related_ledger_entry_id =
        candidate.source_payment_ledger_entry_id
      AND compensation.entry_type = NEW.reason_code
      AND compensation.direction = 'debit'
      AND compensation.occurred_at = NEW.occurred_at
      AND compensation.recorded_at <= NEW.recorded_at
  )
) OR (
  NEW.reason_code NOT IN ('refund', 'chargeback') AND NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM referral_rewards reward
    JOIN referral_reward_candidates candidate
      ON candidate.candidate_id = reward.candidate_id
    WHERE reward.reward_id = NEW.reward_id
      AND candidate.source_payment_ledger_entry_id =

objects.name: trg_referral_transitions_protection_check_guard

CREATE TRIGGER trg_referral_transitions_protection_check_guard
BEFORE INSERT ON referral_reward_transitions
WHEN NEW.transition_scope = 'reward'
  AND NEW.from_status = 'pending'
  AND (
    NEW.to_status = 'confirmed'
    OR (
      NEW.to_status = 'cancelled'
      AND NEW.reason_code IN ('refund', 'chargeback')
      AND NEW.actor_type IN ('workflow', 'system')
    )
  )
  AND NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM referral_reward_protection_checks protection_check
    WHERE protection_check.transition_id = NEW.transition_id
      AND protection_check.reward_id = NEW.reward_id
      AND protection_check.reward_revision = NEW.from_revision
      AND protection_check.reason_code = NEW.reason_code
      AND protection_check.recorded_at <= NEW.recorded_at
      AND (
        (NEW.to_status = 'confirmed'
          AND protection_check.decision = 'confirm'
          AND protection_check.source_payment_ledger_entry_id =
            NEW.related_payment_ledger_entry_id
          AND protection_check.checked_at = NEW.occurred_at)
        OR
        (NEW.to_status = 'cancelled'
          AND protection_check.decision = 'cancel'
          AND protection_check.compensation_ledger_entry_id =
            NEW.related_payment_ledger_entry_id)
      )
  )
BEGIN
  SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'reward transition lacks its protection check');
END

objects.name: trg_referral_transitions_semantic_guard
objects.sql:
CREATE TRIGGER trg_referral_transitions_semantic_guard
BEFORE INSERT ON referral_reward_transitions
WHEN NOT (
  (NEW.transition_scope = 'reward'
    AND NEW.from_status = 'none' AND NEW.to_status = 'pending'
    AND NEW.reason_code = 'candidate_selected'
    AND NEW.actor_type = 'system')
  OR
  (NEW.transition_scope = 'reward'
    AND NEW.from_status = 'pending' AND NEW.to_status = 'confirmed'
    AND NEW.reason_code = 'hold_elapsed'
    AND NEW.actor_type = 'workflow')
  OR
  (NEW.transition_scope = 'reward'
    AND NEW.from_status IN ('pending', 'confirmed')
    AND NEW.to_status = 'cancelled'
    AND NEW.reason_code IN ('refund', 'chargeback')
    AND NEW.actor_type IN ('workflow', 'system'))
  OR
  (NEW.transition_scope = 'reward'
    AND NEW.from_status IN ('pending', 'confirmed')
    AND NEW.to_status = 'cancelled'
    AND NEW.reason_code IN ('fraud', 'policy_violation', 'admin_correction')
    AND NEW.actor_type = 'admin')
  OR
  (NEW.transition_scope = 'bonus_grant'
    AND NEW.from_status = 'none'
    AND NEW.to_status IN ('pending', 'claimable')
    AND NEW.reason_code = 'grant_created'
    AND NEW.actor_type = 'system')
  OR
  (NEW.transition_scope = 'bonus_grant'
    AND NEW.from_status = 'claimable' AND NEW.to_status = 'applied'
    AND NEW.reason_code = 'manual_claim'
    AND NEW.actor_type = 'telegram'
    AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM bonus_access_grants grant_record
      WHERE grant_record.bonus_grant_id = NEW.bonus_grant_id
        AND grant_record.beneficiary_telegram_id = NEW.actor_id
    ))
  OR
  (NEW.transition_scope = 'bonus_grant'
    AND NEW.from_status = 'pending' AND NEW.to_status = 'applied'
    AND NEW.reason_code = 'active_plan_extension'
    AND NEW.actor_type = 'workflow')
  OR
  (NEW.transition_scope = 'bonus_grant'
    AND NEW.from_status = 'claimable' AND NEW.to_status = 'expired'
    AND NEW.reason_code = 'claim_window_expired'
    AND NEW.actor_type = 'workflow')
  OR
  (NEW.transition_scope = 'bonus_grant'
    AND NEW.from_status IN ('pending', 'claimable')
    AND NEW.to_status = 'revoked'
    AND NEW.reason_code IN ('refund', 'chargeback')
    AND NEW.actor_type IN ('workflow', 'system')
    AND NEW.compensated_seconds = 259200)
  OR
  (NEW.transition_scope = 'bonus_grant'
    AND NEW.from_status IN ('pending', 'claimable')
    AND NEW.to_status = 'revoked'
    AND NEW.reason_code IN ('fraud', 'policy_violation', 'admin_correction')
    AND NEW.actor_type = 'admin'
    AND NEW.compensated_seconds = 0)
  OR
  (NEW.transition_scope = 'bonus_grant'
    AND NEW.from_status = 'applied'
    AND NEW.to_status IN ('revoked', 'manual_review')
    AND NEW.reason_code IN ('refund', 'chargeback')
    AND NEW.actor_type IN ('workflow', 'system'))
)
BEGIN
  SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'transition reason or actor is not allowed');
END

objects.name: trg_referral_transitions_time_guard
objects.sql:
CREATE TRIGGER trg_referral_transitions_time_guard
BEFORE INSERT ON referral_reward_transitions
WHEN (
  NEW.from_status != 'none'
  AND NEW.transition_scope = 'reward'
  AND NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM referral_rewards reward
    WHERE reward.reward_id = NEW.reward_id
      AND NEW.recorded_at >= reward.updated_at
  )
) OR (
  NEW.from_status != 'none'
  AND NEW.transition_scope = 'bonus_grant'
  AND NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM bonus_access_grants grant_record
    WHERE grant_record.bonus_grant_id = NEW.bonus_grant_id
      AND NEW.recorded_at >= grant_record.updated_at
  )
) OR (
  NEW.transition_scope = 'reward'
  AND NEW.to_status = 'confirmed'
  AND NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM referral_rewards reward
    WHERE reward.reward_id = NEW.reward_id
      AND NEW.occurred_at >= reward.confirm_after
  )
) OR (
  NEW.transition_scope = 'bonus_grant'
  AND NEW.from_status = 'claimable'
  AND NEW.to_status = 'applied'
  AND NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM bonus_access_grants grant_record
    WHERE grant_record.bonus_grant_id = NEW.bonus_grant_id
      AND NEW.occurred_at BETWEEN
        grant_record.available_at AND grant_record.claim_expires_at
      AND NEW.effect_starts_at = NEW.occurred_at
  )
) OR (
  NEW.transition_scope = 'bonus_grant'
  AND NEW.to_status = 'expired'
  AND NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM bonus_access_grants grant_record
    WHERE grant_record.bonus_grant_id = NEW.bonus_grant_id
      AND NEW.occurred_at > grant_record.claim_expires_at
  )
) OR (
  NEW.transition_scope = 'bonus_grant'
  AND NEW.from_status = 'pending'
  AND NEW.to_status = 'applied'
  AND NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM bonus_access_grants grant_record
    JOIN subscriptions subscription
      ON subscription.subscription_id = grant_record.target_subscription_id
    WHERE grant_record.bonus_grant_id = NEW.bonus_grant_id
      AND subscription.telegram_id = grant_record.beneficiary_telegram_id
      AND subscription.plan_code = grant_record.plan_code
      AND subscription.status IN ('active', 'cancel_at_period_end')
      AND subscription.current_period_end > NEW.occurred_at
      AND NEW.effect_starts_at = subscription.current_period_end
      AND NEW.effect_starts_at >= NEW.occurred_at
  )
)
BEGIN
  SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'transition occurred outside its allowed time');
END

CREATE TRIGGER trg_cabinet_partner_role_invalidates_approval
AFTER UPDATE OF status ON user_roles
WHEN NEW.role = 'partner' AND NEW.status != OLD.status
BEGIN
  INSERT OR IGNORE INTO offer_moderation_decisions (
    offer_code, offer_version_id, decision, from_status, to_status,
    actor_id, actor_role, reason, event_key
  )
  SELECT vr.offer_code, vr.current_version_id, 'approval_invalidated',
    vr.moderation_status, 'not_submitted', 0, 'system',
    'Системная роль партнёра изменилась.',
    'v140-partner-role:' || lower(hex(randomblob(16)))
  FROM partner_profiles pf
  JOIN offer_owners ow ON ow.partner_profile_id = pf.id
    AND ow.owner_kind = 'partner'
  JOIN offer_visibility_rules vr ON vr.offer_code = ow.offer_code
  WHERE pf.telegram_id = NEW.telegram_id
    AND (vr.moderation_status != 'not_submitted' OR vr.visibility != 'private');
  UPDATE offer_visibility_rules
  SET moderation_status = 'not_submitted', visibility = 'private',
      submitted_version_id = NULL, approved_version_id = NULL,
      published_at = NULL, updated_by = 0, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
  WHERE offer_code IN (
    SELECT ow.offer_code FROM partner_profiles pf
    JOIN offer_owners ow ON ow.partner_profile_id = pf.id
      AND ow.owner_kind = 'partner'
    WHERE pf.telegram_id = NEW.telegram_id
  ) AND (moderation_status != 'not_submitted' OR visibility != 'private');
END

objects.name: analytics_v139_active_shadow_authority
objects.sql:
CREATE VIEW analytics_v139_active_shadow_authority AS
SELECT 1 AS active FROM analytics_v2_settings settings
JOIN analytics_v139_owner_runtime audience ON audience.id = 1
WHERE settings.id = 1 AND settings.rollout_mode = 'admin_shadow'
  AND settings.master_enabled = 1 AND settings.ingest_enabled = 1
  AND settings.projections_enabled = 1 AND settings.ambassador_enabled = 1
  AND audience.audience_mode = 'owner_only' AND audience.enabled = 1
  AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM analytics_privacy_projection_fence)

objects.name: cabinet_application_journey_v1
objects.sql:
CREATE VIEW cabinet_application_journey_v1 AS
SELECT
  bridge.application_id,
  bridge.result_id,
  bridge.source_lead_id,
  bridge.offer_cycle_id,
  bridge.offer_code,
  bridge.owner_partner_profile_id,
  bridge.plan_code,
  bridge.access_state,
  bridge.terminal_status,
  bridge.result_code,
  bridge.event_id,
  bridge.event_name,
  bridge.actor_pseudonym,
  bridge.occurred_at,
  bridge.recorded_at
FROM cabinet_application_analytics_bridges bridge
JOIN canonical_analytics_events event
  ON event.event_id = bridge.event_id
  AND event.event_key = bridge.event_key
  AND event.payload_hash = bridge.payload_hash

objects.name: plan_aliases_current
objects.sql:
CREATE VIEW plan_aliases_current AS
SELECT a.alias_code, a.alias_version, a.alias_kind, a.target_plan_code,
       a.target_access_state, a.resolution_mode, a.accepts_new_writes,
       a.note, a.created_at
FROM plan_aliases a
WHERE a.alias_version = (
  SELECT MAX(next_alias.alias_version)
  FROM plan_aliases next_alias
  WHERE next_alias.alias_code = a.alias_code COLLATE NOCASE
)
